"""
Fingerprint Agent — device-based WebSocket client (Hỗ trợ WSS + HTTPS)
"""
import asyncio
import base64
import http.server
import json
import os
import signal
import ssl
import sys
import threading
import time          # ★ cho idle watchdog
import uuid
from typing import Optional

if hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
if hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

import websockets
from dotenv import load_dotenv

_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
load_dotenv(os.path.join(_HERE, ".env"))

BACKEND_WS_URL = os.getenv("BACKEND_WS_URL", "ws://localhost:8000/ws/fingerprint")
BRIDGE_TOKEN = os.getenv("BRIDGE_TOKEN", "")
DEVICE_SERVER_HOST = os.getenv("DEVICE_SERVER_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
DEVICE_SERVER_PORT = int(os.getenv("DEVICE_SERVER_PORT", "9001"))

# ★ Idle timeout: tự đóng thiết bị nếu không dùng trong N giây
DEVICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT = int(os.getenv("DEVICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT", "60"))

CA_CERT_PATH = os.getenv("CA_CERT_PATH", "rootCA.pem")
USE_TLS = BACKEND_WS_URL.lower().startswith("wss://")

if not BRIDGE_TOKEN or len(BRIDGE_TOKEN) < 16:
    print("❌ BRIDGE_TOKEN thiếu hoặc <16 ký tự trong .env")
    sys.exit(1)

from zk_service import ZK9500Service

DEVICE_ID_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "device_id.txt")

def build_ssl_context():
    if not USE_TLS:
        return None

    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()

    ca_path = CA_CERT_PATH
    if not os.path.isabs(ca_path):
        ca_path = os.path.join(_HERE, ca_path)

    if os.path.exists(ca_path):
        try:
            ctx.load_verify_locations(cafile=ca_path)
            print(f"[Agent] 🔒 Đã nạp CA: {ca_path}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[Agent] ⚠️ Lỗi nạp CA '{ca_path}': {e}")
            print(f"[Agent]    Sẽ dùng CA hệ thống Windows thay thế.")
    else:
        print(f"[Agent] ⚠️ Không tìm thấy CA file: {ca_path}")
        print(f"[Agent]    Đang dùng CA hệ thống Windows.")

    return ctx

def get_or_create_device_id() -> str:
    if os.path.exists(DEVICE_ID_FILE):
        with open(DEVICE_ID_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            did = f.read().strip()
            if did:
                return did
    did = "DEV-" + str(uuid.uuid4())
    with open(DEVICE_ID_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(did)
    return did

def free_port(port: int):
    try:
        import subprocess
        res = subprocess.run(["netstat", "-ano"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        my_pid = str(os.getpid())
        killed_any = False
        for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
            if f":{port}" in line and "LISTENING" in line:
                parts = line.strip().split()
                pid = parts[-1]
                if pid != my_pid and pid != "0":
                    print(f"[Agent] 🔄 Phát hiện PID {pid} đang chiếm cổng {port}. Đang kill để giải phóng...")
                    subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/F", "/PID", pid], capture_output=True)
                    killed_any = True
        if killed_any:
            time.sleep(1.2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Agent] ⚠️ Lỗi kiểm tra cổng {port}: {e}")

def start_device_id_server(device_id: str, host: str, port: int, agent_ref=None):
    free_port(port)

    class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_OPTIONS(self):
            self.send_response(204)
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, OPTIONS")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "*")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network", "true")
            self.end_headers()

        def do_GET(self):
            if self.path == "/device-id":
                body = json.dumps({"device_id": device_id, "service": "qk7-fingerprint-agent"}).encode()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network", "true")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)
            elif self.path == "/health":
                body = json.dumps({"ok": True}).encode()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network", "true")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)
            elif self.path == "/enroll-status":
                status = agent_ref.get_enroll_status() if agent_ref else {
                    "enrolling": False, "step": 0, "total": 3, "state": "idle"
                }
                body = json.dumps(status).encode()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, OPTIONS")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "*")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network", "true")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)
            else:
                self.send_response(404)
                self.end_headers()

        def log_message(self, *args):
            pass

    server = None
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            free_port(port)
            server = http.server.HTTPServer((host, port), Handler)
            t = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
            t.start()
            print(f"[Agent] Device-id server: http://{host}:{port}/device-id")
            return server
        except OSError as e:
            if attempt < 2:
                print(f"[Agent] ⚠️ Cổng {port} chưa sẵn sàng ({e}), đang thử kill và mở lại lần {attempt + 2}...")
                free_port(port)
                time.sleep(1.5)
            else:
                print(f"[Agent] ❌ Không mở được {host}:{port}: {e}.")
                return None

class FingerprintAgent:
    def __init__(self, device_id: str, ssl_context=None):
        self.svc = ZK9500Service()
        self.device_id = device_id
        self.ssl_context = ssl_context
        self.running = True
        self.reconnect_delay = 3
        self.busy = False
        self.enroll_step = 0
        self.enroll_total = 3
        self.enroll_state = "idle"
        self._cancel_event = threading.Event()

        # Quản lý đóng/mở thiết bị (Lazy Open)
        self.active_jobs = 0
        self.device_lock = threading.Lock()

        # ★ Idle timeout
        self._last_activity_ts = time.monotonic()
        self._idle_timeout = DEVICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT
        self._idle_task: Optional[asyncio.Task] = None

    # ─────────────────────────── Device lifecycle ───────────────────────────

    def _ensure_device_open(self) -> bool:
        with self.device_lock:
            self._last_activity_ts = time.monotonic()
            if self.svc.device_connected:
                self.active_jobs += 1
                return True
            print("[Agent] 🎬 Mở thiết bị ZK9500 (Lazy Open)...")
            ok, msg = self.svc.open_device()
            print(f"[Agent] Open device: {msg}")
            if ok:
                self.active_jobs += 1
            return ok

    def _release_device(self):
        """
        ★ Gia cố: close_device() có thể raise (USB rút giữa chừng).
        Không được để exception lan ra — chỉ log và tiếp tục.
        """
        with self.device_lock:
            self._last_activity_ts = time.monotonic()
            self.active_jobs -= 1
            if self.active_jobs <= 0:
                self.active_jobs = 0
                if self.svc.device_connected:
                    try:
                        self.svc.close_device()
                        print("[Agent] 🔌 Đã nhả thiết bị ZK9500 (Tránh nóng)")
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"[Agent] ⚠️ close_device() lỗi: {e} — đánh dấu disconnected")
                        try:
                            self.svc.device_connected = False
                        except Exception:
                            pass

    async def _idle_watchdog(self):
        """★ Tự đóng thiết bị khi idle quá lâu (không có job nào)."""
        while self.running:
            await asyncio.sleep(3)
            try:
                with self.device_lock:
                    if self.active_jobs <= 0 and self.svc.device_connected:
                        idle = time.monotonic() - self._last_activity_ts
                        if idle >= self._idle_timeout:
                            print(f"[Agent] 😴 Idle {idle:.0f}s ≥ "
                                  f"{self._idle_timeout}s — tự đóng thiết bị")
                            try:
                                self.svc.close_device()
                            except Exception as e:
                                print(f"[Agent] idle watchdog close lỗi: {e}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[Agent] idle watchdog: {e}")

    def get_enroll_status(self):
        return {
            "enrolling": bool(self.busy and self.enroll_state not in
                              ("idle", "completed", "error", "timeout",
                               "mismatch", "cancelled")),
            "step": self.enroll_step,
            "total": self.enroll_total,
            "state": self.enroll_state,
        }

    # ─────────────────────────── Main loop ───────────────────────────

    async def run(self):
        ok, msg = self.svc.load_sdk()
        print(f"[Agent] Load SDK: {msg}")
        if not ok:
            print("❌ Không load được SDK.")
            return

        # ★ Khởi động idle watchdog
        self._idle_task = asyncio.create_task(self._idle_watchdog())

        print(f"[Agent] Device ID: {self.device_id}")
        proto_info = "WSS (TLS)" if USE_TLS else "WS (plaintext)"
        print(f"[Agent] Giao thức: {proto_info}")
        print(f"[Agent] Idle timeout: {self._idle_timeout}s")
        print(f"[Agent] Sẵn sàng. Kết nối tới {BACKEND_WS_URL}...\n")

        retry_count = 0
        try:
            while self.running:
                try:
                    await self._session()
                    retry_count = 0
                except ssl.SSLError as e:
                    print(f"[Agent] ❌ Lỗi SSL: {e}")
                    print(f"[Agent]    Kiểm tra: file 'rootCA.pem' có trong {_HERE}?")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"[Agent] Session error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")

                if self.running:
                    delay = min(3 * (2 ** retry_count), 30)
                    print(f"[Agent] Reconnect sau {delay}s...")
                    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
                    retry_count += 1
        finally:
            if self._idle_task:
                self._idle_task.cancel()

    async def _session(self):
        url = f"{BACKEND_WS_URL}?device_id={self.device_id}&bridge_token={BRIDGE_TOKEN}"

        connect_kwargs = {"ping_interval": None}
        if self.ssl_context is not None:
            connect_kwargs["ssl"] = self.ssl_context

        async with websockets.connect(url, **connect_kwargs) as ws:
            print(f"[Agent] ✅ WS connected ({'wss' if USE_TLS else 'ws'}://...)")
            async for raw in ws:
                try:
                    msg = json.loads(raw)
                except Exception:
                    continue
                t = msg.get("type")
                if t == "ping":
                    try:
                        await ws.send(json.dumps({"type": "pong"}))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                elif t == "scan_request":
                    self._cancel_event.set()
                    new_event = threading.Event()
                    self._cancel_event = new_event
                    asyncio.create_task(self._handle_scan(ws, msg, new_event))
                elif t == "enroll_request":
                    self._cancel_event.set()
                    new_event = threading.Event()
                    self._cancel_event = new_event
                    asyncio.create_task(self._handle_enroll(ws, msg, new_event))

    # ─────────────────────────── Handlers ───────────────────────────

    async def _handle_scan(self, ws, job, cancel_event: threading.Event):
        """
        ★ Gia cố: BẮT BUỘC gửi scan_result (match=False) trong MỌI nhánh lỗi.
        - Outer try bao trùm cả _ensure_device_open và validate input
        - finally bọc try/except để close_device() throw không giết task
        """
        job_id = job.get("job_id")
        device_acquired = False  # ★ Theo dõi để balance active_jobs chính xác

        try:
            template_b64 = job.get("template_plain_b64")
            timeout = int(job.get("timeout_seconds", 30) or 30)

            print(f"\n[Agent] 📥 scan {job_id} | timeout={timeout}s")

            # ★ BƯỚC 1 — Validate input SỚM (trước khi chạm phần cứng)
            if not job_id:
                print("[Agent] ❌ scan: thiếu job_id — bỏ qua")
                return
            if not template_b64:
                await ws.send(json.dumps({
                    "type": "scan_result", "job_id": job_id,
                    "match": False, "score": 0,
                    "error": "INVALID_TEMPLATE",
                }))
                return

            # ★ BƯỚC 2 — Mở thiết bị trong try (bắt mọi lỗi USB/SDK)
            try:
                device_acquired = self._ensure_device_open()
            except Exception as open_err:
                print(f"[Agent] ❌ open_device() raise: {open_err}")
                device_acquired = False

            if not device_acquired:
                await ws.send(json.dumps({
                    "type": "scan_result", "job_id": job_id,
                    "match": False, "score": 0, "error": "DEVICE_OFFLINE",
                }))
                return

            print(f"[Agent] 👉 Đặt tay lên máy quét...")

            # ★ BƯỚC 3 — Quét + so khớp
            stored = base64.b64decode(template_b64)
            scanned = await asyncio.to_thread(
                self.svc.wait_for_finger, timeout, cancel_event
            )

            if cancel_event.is_set():
                print(f"[Agent] ⏹️ Scan {job_id} bị hủy bởi job mới.")
                await ws.send(json.dumps({
                    "type": "scan_result", "job_id": job_id,
                    "match": False, "score": 0, "error": "CANCELLED",
                }))
                return

            if scanned is None:
                await ws.send(json.dumps({
                    "type": "scan_result", "job_id": job_id,
                    "match": False, "score": 0, "error": "TIMEOUT",
                }))
                return

            matched, score = await asyncio.to_thread(
                self.svc.compare_templates, stored, scanned
            )
            print(f"[Agent] {'✅' if matched else '❌'} {job_id}: match={matched} score={score}")
            await ws.send(json.dumps({
                "type": "scan_result", "job_id": job_id,
                "match": matched, "score": score,
            }))

        except Exception as e:
            # ★ LƯỚI AN TOÀN CUỐI — mọi exception chưa được bắt ở trên đều rơi vào đây
            print(f"[Agent] ❌ scan exception: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
            try:
                await ws.send(json.dumps({
                    "type": "scan_result", "job_id": job_id,
                    "match": False, "score": 0,
                    "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:180]}",
                }))
            except Exception as send_err:
                # WS đã đóng — không còn cách nào báo frontend, chỉ log
                print(f"[Agent] ⚠️ Không gửi được scan_result lỗi: {send_err}")

        finally:
            # ★ Bọc release_device trong try riêng — close_device() lỗi không được
            #   ghi đè exception gốc hoặc làm task crash
            if device_acquired:
                try:
                    self._release_device()
                except Exception as rel_err:
                    print(f"[Agent] ⚠️ release_device error: {rel_err}")

    async def _handle_enroll(self, ws, job, cancel_event: threading.Event):
        """
        ★ Gia cố cùng pattern với _handle_scan:
        - Outer try bao trùm _ensure_device_open
        - device_acquired flag balance active_jobs
        - finally luôn reset busy + enroll_state, bọc release_device an toàn
        - Mọi nhánh lỗi đều gửi enroll_result (success=False)
        """
        job_id = job.get("job_id")
        user_id = job.get("user_id")
        device_acquired = False

        try:
            step_timeout = max(10, int(job.get("timeout_seconds", 60) or 60) // 3)

            print(f"\n[Agent] 📥 enroll {job_id} | user={user_id} | {step_timeout}s/lần")

            # ★ Validate job_id
            if not job_id:
                print("[Agent] ❌ enroll: thiếu job_id — bỏ qua")
                return

            # ★ Mở thiết bị trong try
            try:
                device_acquired = self._ensure_device_open()
            except Exception as open_err:
                print(f"[Agent] ❌ enroll open_device() raise: {open_err}")
                device_acquired = False

            if not device_acquired:
                await ws.send(json.dumps({
                    "type": "enroll_result", "job_id": job_id,
                    "success": False, "error": "DEVICE_OFFLINE",
                }))
                return

            self.busy = True
            self.enroll_step = 0
            self.enroll_total = 3
            self.enroll_state = "waiting_touch_1"

            templates = []
            for i in range(3):
                self.enroll_step = i
                self.enroll_state = f"waiting_touch_{i+1}"

                if cancel_event.is_set():
                    print(f"[Agent] ⏹️ Enroll {job_id} bị hủy trước lần {i+1}.")
                    self.enroll_state = "cancelled"
                    try:
                        await ws.send(json.dumps({
                            "type": "enroll_result", "job_id": job_id,
                            "success": False, "error": "CANCELLED",
                        }))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    return

                print(f"[Agent] 👉 Lần {i+1}/3 — Đặt tay...")
                t = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.svc.wait_for_finger, step_timeout, cancel_event
                )

                if cancel_event.is_set():
                    print(f"[Agent] ⏹️ Enroll {job_id} bị hủy sau lần {i+1}.")
                    self.enroll_state = "cancelled"
                    try:
                        await ws.send(json.dumps({
                            "type": "enroll_result", "job_id": job_id,
                            "success": False, "error": "CANCELLED",
                        }))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    return

                if t is None:
                    self.enroll_state = "timeout"
                    try:
                        await ws.send(json.dumps({
                            "type": "enroll_result", "job_id": job_id,
                            "success": False,
                            "error": f"Lần {i+1} quét không thành công sau {step_timeout}s. Vui lòng thử lại.",
                        }))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    return

                if i > 0:
                    matched, score = await asyncio.to_thread(
                        self.svc.compare_templates, templates[0], t
                    )
                    if not matched:
                        self.enroll_state = "mismatch"
                        try:
                            await ws.send(json.dumps({
                                "type": "enroll_result", "job_id": job_id,
                                "success": False,
                                "error": f"Lần {i+1} không khớp ngón ban đầu. Vui lòng thử lại.",
                            }))
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                        return

                templates.append(t)
                self.enroll_step = i + 1
                self.enroll_state = f"captured_{i+1}" if (i + 1 < 3) else "merging"
                print(f"[Agent] ✓ Ghi nhận ngón tay lần {i+1}/3 thành công")
                try:
                    await ws.send(json.dumps({
                        "type": "enroll_progress", "job_id": job_id,
                        "step": i + 1, "total": 3,
                    }))
                except Exception:
                    pass
                await asyncio.sleep(0.8)

            if cancel_event.is_set():
                print(f"[Agent] ⏹️ Enroll {job_id} bị hủy trước khi merge.")
                self.enroll_state = "cancelled"
                try:
                    await ws.send(json.dumps({
                        "type": "enroll_result", "job_id": job_id,
                        "success": False, "error": "CANCELLED",
                    }))
                except Exception:
                    pass
                return

            from zk_service import to_csharp_byte_array
            result = self.svc.zk.DBMerge(
                to_csharp_byte_array(templates[0]),
                to_csharp_byte_array(templates[1]),
                to_csharp_byte_array(templates[2]),
            )
            merged_bytes = bytes(result[0]) if isinstance(result, tuple) else bytes(result)
            print(f"[Agent] ✅ enroll {job_id} done, merged={len(merged_bytes)}B")
            self.enroll_state = "completed"

            await ws.send(json.dumps({
                "type": "enroll_result", "job_id": job_id,
                "success": True,
                "template_b64": base64.b64encode(merged_bytes).decode(),
            }))

        except Exception as e:
            # ★ LƯỚI AN TOÀN CUỐI
            self.enroll_state = "error"
            print(f"[Agent] ❌ enroll exception: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
            try:
                await ws.send(json.dumps({
                    "type": "enroll_result", "job_id": job_id,
                    "success": False,
                    "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:180]}",
                }))
            except Exception as send_err:
                print(f"[Agent] ⚠️ Không gửi được enroll_result lỗi: {send_err}")

        finally:
            # ★ Luôn reset state, không phụ thuộc vào nhánh điều khiển nào ở trên
            self.busy = False
            if self.enroll_state not in ("completed", "cancelled", "error", "timeout", "mismatch"):
                self.enroll_state = "idle"

            if device_acquired:
                try:
                    self._release_device()
                except Exception as rel_err:
                    print(f"[Agent] ⚠️ enroll release_device error: {rel_err}")

def main():
    device_id = get_or_create_device_id()
    ssl_ctx = build_ssl_context()
    agent = FingerprintAgent(device_id, ssl_context=ssl_ctx)
    start_device_id_server(device_id, DEVICE_SERVER_HOST, DEVICE_SERVER_PORT, agent)

    def _stop(*_):
        agent.running = False
        agent.svc.close()
        sys.exit(0)

    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _stop)

    try:
        asyncio.run(agent.run())
    finally:
        agent.svc.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
ZK9500 Service — QK7 Fingerprint Bridge
"""
import hashlib
import os
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

try:
    from pyzkfp import ZKFP2
    import pyzkfp.zkfp2 as _zk_internal

    _Array = getattr(_zk_internal, "Array", None)
    _Byte = getattr(_zk_internal, "Byte", None)
    _PYZKFP_OK = True
    _IMPORT_ERR = ""
except Exception as e:
    ZKFP2 = None
    _Array = _Byte = None
    _PYZKFP_OK = False
    _IMPORT_ERR = str(e)


def to_csharp_byte_array(data: Any) -> Any:
    if not _PYZKFP_OK or data is None or _Array is None or _Byte is None:
        return data
    if isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
        return _Array[_Byte](data)
    return data


class ZK9500Service:
    def __init__(self):
        self.zk: Optional[Any] = None
        self.sdk_loaded: bool = False
        self.device_connected: bool = False
        self.device_serial: str = "N/A"
        self.width: int = 288
        self.height: int = 375

        self._uid_to_sid: Dict[str, int] = {}
        self._sid_to_uid: Dict[int, str] = {}
        self._sid_to_template: Dict[int, bytes] = {}

        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._scan_lock = threading.Lock()

    # ─────────────────────────── SDK lifecycle ───────────────────────────

    def load_sdk(self) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        if not _PYZKFP_OK:
            return False, f"pyzkfp không import được: {_IMPORT_ERR}"
        try:
            self.zk = ZKFP2()
            try:
                self.zk.Terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.zk.Init()
            self.sdk_loaded = True
            if getattr(self.zk, "width", None):
                self.width = int(self.zk.width)
            if getattr(self.zk, "height", None):
                self.height = int(self.zk.height)
            return True, "SDK đã load"
        except Exception as e:
            self.sdk_loaded = False
            return False, f"Init SDK lỗi: {e}"

    def open_device(self) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Mở thiết bị (Lazy Open). Nếu lần đóng trước đã Terminate → Init lại."""
        with self._lock:
            # ★ Lazy Init: sau full reset, cần Init lại SDK trước khi OpenDevice
            if self.zk and not self.sdk_loaded:
                try:
                    self.zk.Init()
                    self.sdk_loaded = True
                    print("[ZK] ✅ Lazy Init OK")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"[ZK] ⚠️ Lazy Init lỗi: {e}")
                    self.sdk_loaded = False

            if not self.sdk_loaded:
                ok, msg = self.load_sdk()
                if not ok:
                    return False, f"SDK chưa load: {msg}"

            try:
                n = self.zk.GetDeviceCount() if (self.zk and self.sdk_loaded) else 0
                if n <= 0:
                    # Nếu n <= 0 sau thời gian dài không hoạt động, tự động reload SDK tươi để kích hoạt lại cổng USB
                    print("[ZK] ⚠️ GetDeviceCount <= 0. Đang reload SDK để đánh thức thiết bị ZK9500...")
                    ok, msg = self.load_sdk()
                    if ok and self.zk:
                        n = self.zk.GetDeviceCount()

                if n <= 0:
                    return False, "Không tìm thấy đầu đọc ZK9500 (Vui lòng cắm cáp USB)"

                self.zk.OpenDevice(0)
                raw_sn = getattr(self.zk, "dev_serial_number", "ZK9500")
                if isinstance(raw_sn, str):
                    self.device_serial = raw_sn.replace("\x00", "").strip() or "ZK9500"
                else:
                    self.device_serial = "ZK9500"
                self.device_connected = True
                return True, f"Đã mở {self.device_serial} ({self.width}x{self.height})"
            except Exception as e:
                self.device_connected = False
                # Nếu OpenDevice ném ngoại lệ, tự động reload lại SDK instance
                try:
                    self.load_sdk()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                return False, f"OpenDevice lỗi: {e}"

    def close_device(self, full_reset: Optional[bool] = None):
        """
        Đóng thiết bị vật lý (tắt LED/sensor).
        Mặc định full_reset=True → gọi Terminate() để giải phóng USB handle
        (đảm bảo LED tắt hẳn). Có thể tắt bằng env DEVICE_FULL_RESET_ON_CLOSE=false.
        """
        with self._lock:
            # 1) CloseDevice — KHÔNG nuốt lỗi im lặng nữa
            if self.device_connected and self.zk:
                try:
                    self.zk.CloseDevice()
                    print("[ZK] ✅ CloseDevice")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"[ZK] ⚠️ CloseDevice lỗi: {e}")
            self.device_connected = False

            # 2) Full reset để nhả USB handle
            if full_reset is None:
                full_reset = os.getenv(
                    "DEVICE_FULL_RESET_ON_CLOSE", "true"
                ).lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")

            if full_reset and self.zk and self.sdk_loaded:
                try:
                    self.zk.Terminate()
                    print("[ZK] ✅ Terminate (giải phóng USB)")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"[ZK] ⚠️ Terminate lỗi: {e}")
                # Đánh dấu cần Init lại — open_device() sẽ Init lazily
                self.sdk_loaded = False

    def close(self):
        """Đóng hoàn toàn (dùng khi tắt Agent)."""
        self.close_device()
        with self._lock:
            if self.sdk_loaded and self.zk:
                try:
                    self.zk.Terminate()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.sdk_loaded = False
            self.zk = None

    # ─────────────────────────── Template store ───────────────────────────

    @staticmethod
    def _hash_user_id(user_id: str) -> int:
        h = hashlib.sha256(user_id.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        sid = int(h[:7], 16)
        return sid if sid > 0 else 1

    def _assign(self, user_id: str) -> int:
        if user_id in self._uid_to_sid:
            return self._uid_to_sid[user_id]
        sid = self._hash_user_id(user_id)
        if sid in self._sid_to_uid and self._sid_to_uid[sid] != user_id:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Hash collision: {user_id} vs {self._sid_to_uid[sid]}")
        self._uid_to_sid[user_id] = sid
        self._sid_to_uid[sid] = user_id
        return sid

    def sync_templates(self, items: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
        if not self.sdk_loaded or not self.zk:
            return 0
        import base64
        count = 0
        with self._lock:
            try:
                self.zk.DBClear()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._sid_to_template.clear()
            for it in items:
                uid = it.get("user_id")
                b64 = it.get("template_b64")
                if not uid or not b64:
                    continue
                try:
                    tpl = base64.b64decode(b64)
                    sid = self._assign(uid)
                    self.zk.DBAdd(sid, to_csharp_byte_array(tpl))
                    self._sid_to_template[sid] = tpl
                    count += 1
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"[sync] skip {uid}: {e}")
        return count

    def add_template(self, user_id: str, template_bytes: bytes) -> int:
        if not self.sdk_loaded or not self.zk:
            raise RuntimeError("SDK chưa load")
        sid = self._assign(user_id)
        with self._lock:
            self.zk.DBAdd(sid, to_csharp_byte_array(template_bytes))
            self._sid_to_template[sid] = template_bytes
        return sid

    def remove_template(self, user_id: str) -> bool:
        if not self.sdk_loaded or not self.zk:
            return False
        sid = self._uid_to_sid.get(user_id)
        if sid is None:
            return False
        with self._lock:
            try:
                self.zk.DBDel(sid)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._uid_to_sid.pop(user_id, None)
            self._sid_to_uid.pop(sid, None)
            self._sid_to_template.pop(sid, None)
        return True

    # ─────────────────────────── Scan / Compare ───────────────────────────

    def _capture_once(self) -> Optional[bytes]:
        if not self.device_connected or not self.zk:
            return None
        try:
            res = self.zk.AcquireFingerprint()
            if res is not None:
                raw_template, _img = res
                return bytes(raw_template)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return None

    def wait_for_finger(self, timeout: float = 30.0, cancel_event=None) -> Optional[bytes]:
        if not self.device_connected:
            raise RuntimeError("Thiết bị chưa mở")
        if not self._scan_lock.acquire(timeout=timeout):
            return None
        try:
            start = time.time()
            while time.time() - start < timeout:
                if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
                    return None
                t = self._capture_once()
                if t is not None:
                    time.sleep(0.01)  # wait for LED off
                    return t
                time.sleep(0.02)
            return None
        finally:
            self._scan_lock.release()

    def identify_against_ram(self, template_bytes: bytes) -> Tuple[Optional[str], int]:
        if not self.sdk_loaded or not self.zk:
            return None, 0
        with self._lock:
            try:
                fid, score = self.zk.DBIdentify(to_csharp_byte_array(template_bytes))
                if fid and fid > 0:
                    uid = self._sid_to_uid.get(fid)
                    return uid, int(score)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[identify] {e}")
        return None, 0

    def compare_templates(self, t1_bytes: bytes, t2_bytes: bytes) -> Tuple[bool, int]:
        if not self.sdk_loaded or not self.zk:
            raise RuntimeError("SDK chưa load")

        TEMP_ID = 999_999_999

        with self._lock:
            cached = list(self._sid_to_template.items())

            try:
                self.zk.DBClear()
                self.zk.DBAdd(TEMP_ID, to_csharp_byte_array(t1_bytes))

                try:
                    fid, score = self.zk.DBIdentify(to_csharp_byte_array(t2_bytes))
                finally:
                    try:
                        self.zk.DBDel(TEMP_ID)
                    except Exception:
                        pass

                threshold = int(os.getenv("MATCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD", "45"))
                matched = (fid == TEMP_ID)
                final_score = int(score) if matched else 0
                return (matched and final_score >= threshold, final_score)
            finally:
                if cached:
                    try:
                        self.zk.DBClear()
                        for sid, tpl in cached:
                            self.zk.DBAdd(sid, to_csharp_byte_array(tpl))
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"[compare] restore cache fail: {e}")

@echo off
chcp 65001 >nul
title QK7 Fingerprint Agent - Server
cd /d "%~dp0"

echo ==========================================
echo   QK7 FINGERPRINT AGENT - SERVER
echo ==========================================
echo.

if not exist "..\.env" (
    echo [LOI] Khong tim thay ..\.env
    echo File .env phai nam o thu muc goc qk7-datahub
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

REM ─── Doc .env root ───
for /f "usebackq eol=# tokens=1,* delims==" %%a in ("..\.env") do (
    call set "%%a=%%b"
)

REM ─── Trim khoang trang thua (an toan) ───
for /f "tokens=* delims= " %%a in ("%SERVER_IP%") do set "SERVER_IP=%%a"
for /f "tokens=* delims= " %%a in ("%FINGERPRINT_BRIDGE_TOKEN%") do set "FINGERPRINT_BRIDGE_TOKEN=%%a"
for /f "tokens=* delims= " %%a in ("%USE_HTTPS%") do set "USE_HTTPS=%%a"

REM ─── Validate ───
if not defined SERVER_IP (
    echo [LOI] Khong doc duoc SERVER_IP tu ..\.env
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
if not defined FINGERPRINT_BRIDGE_TOKEN (
    echo [LOI] Khong doc duoc FINGERPRINT_BRIDGE_TOKEN tu ..\.env
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
if not defined PORT_BACKEND set "PORT_BACKEND=8000"
if not defined PORT_CLIENT_AGENT set "PORT_CLIENT_AGENT=9001"
if not defined MATCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD set "MATCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD=45"
if not defined MATCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD set "MATCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD=45"
REM ★ MỚI: idle timeout + full reset
if not defined DEVICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT set "DEVICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT=60"
if not defined DEVICE_FULL_RESET_ON_CLOSE set "DEVICE_FULL_RESET_ON_CLOSE=true"

REM ─── Xac dinh protocol ───
if /i "%USE_HTTPS%"=="true" (
    if defined SERVER_DOMAIN (
        set "WS_URL=wss://%SERVER_DOMAIN%/ws/fingerprint"
    ) else (
        set "WS_URL=wss://%SERVER_IP%:%PORT_BACKEND%/ws/fingerprint"
    )
    set "PROTO=WSS (TLS)"
) else (
    set "WS_URL=ws://%SERVER_IP%:%PORT_BACKEND%/ws/fingerprint"
    set "PROTO=WS (plaintext)"
)

REM ─── [FIX] Kiem tra CA cert khi bat HTTPS ───
set "CA_PATH="
if /i "%USE_HTTPS%"=="true" (
    if exist "rootCA.pem" (
        set "CA_PATH=rootCA.pem"
    ) else (
        echo [CANH BAO] USE_HTTPS=true nhung thieu rootCA.pem
        echo    Agent se dung Windows Trust Store ^(phai cai cert truoc^)
        echo    Hoac copy rootCA.pem vao: %CD%
    )
)

REM ─── Kiem tra file bat buoc ───
if not exist "agent.py" (
    echo [LOI] Khong tim thay agent.py trong %CD%
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
if not exist "zk_service.py" (
    echo [LOI] Khong tim thay zk_service.py trong %CD%
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
REM ─── Tu dong dong bo thu vien DLL ZKTeco 64-bit ───
if not exist "libzkfp.dll" (
    if exist "C:\Windows\System32\libzkfp.dll" copy /y "C:\Windows\System32\libzkfp.dll" "libzkfp.dll" >nul 2>&1
)
if not exist "fpslib.dll" (
    if exist "C:\Windows\System32\fpslib.dll" copy /y "C:\Windows\System32\fpslib.dll" "fpslib.dll" >nul 2>&1
)
if not exist "zkfinger10.dll" (
    if exist "C:\Windows\System32\zkfinger10.dll" copy /y "C:\Windows\System32\zkfinger10.dll" "zkfinger10.dll" >nul 2>&1
)
if not exist "ZKFPCap.dll" (
    if exist "C:\Windows\System32\ZKFPCap.dll" copy /y "C:\Windows\System32\ZKFPCap.dll" "ZKFPCap.dll" >nul 2>&1
)
if not exist "libzksensorcore.dll" (
    if exist "C:\Windows\System32\libzksensorcore.dll" copy /y "C:\Windows\System32\libzksensorcore.dll" "libzksensorcore.dll" >nul 2>&1
)
if not exist "zkfpslibLow.dll" (
    if exist "C:\Windows\System32\zkfpslibLow.dll" copy /y "C:\Windows\System32\zkfpslibLow.dll" "zkfpslibLow.dll" >nul 2>&1
)

REM ─── Sinh .env cho agent ───
echo [INFO] Dang dong bo .env tu ..\.env...
(
    echo # Auto-generated tu s-agent.bat ^(SERVER^) - KHONG sua tay
    echo # Sinh luc: %DATE% %TIME%
    echo BACKEND_WS_URL=%WS_URL%
    echo BRIDGE_TOKEN=%FINGERPRINT_BRIDGE_TOKEN%
    echo DEVICE_SERVER_HOST=127.0.0.1
    echo DEVICE_SERVER_PORT=%PORT_CLIENT_AGENT%
    echo MATCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD=%MATCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD%
    echo MATCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD=%MATCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD%
    echo DEVICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT=%DEVICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT%
    echo DEVICE_FULL_RESET_ON_CLOSE=%DEVICE_FULL_RESET_ON_CLOSE%
) > ".env"

if defined CA_PATH echo CA_CERT_PATH=%CA_PATH%>> ".env"

echo [OK] Da sinh .env

REM ─── Kiem tra Python + pyzkfp ───
where python >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [LOI] Khong tim thay Python trong PATH
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

python -c "import pyzkfp" >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [LOI] Chua cai module pyzkfp
    echo Chay: pip install -r requirements.txt
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

REM ─── Hien thi cau hinh ───
set "T=%FINGERPRINT_BRIDGE_TOKEN:~0,16%"

echo.
echo --- Cau hinh hien tai ---
echo   Config root:   ..\.env
echo   Server IP:     %SERVER_IP%
if defined SERVER_DOMAIN echo   Server Domain: %SERVER_DOMAIN%
echo   WebSocket:     %WS_URL%
echo   Protocol:      %PROTO%
if defined CA_PATH (
    echo   CA Cert:       %CA_PATH%
) else (
    if /i "%USE_HTTPS%"=="true" echo   CA Cert:       ^(Windows Trust Store^)
)
echo   Device Port:   %PORT_CLIENT_AGENT%
echo   Bridge Token:  %T%...
echo.
echo   Tram kiem soat: http://127.0.0.1:%PORT_CLIENT_AGENT%/device-id
echo.

REM ─── Giai phong cong %PORT_CLIENT_AGENT% neu dang bi chiem ───
for /f "tokens=5" %%p in ('netstat -a -n -o ^| findstr ":%PORT_CLIENT_AGENT% " ^| findstr "LISTENING"') do (
    if not "%%p"=="0" (
        echo [PORT %PORT_CLIENT_AGENT%] Phat hien PID %%p dang chiem cong %PORT_CLIENT_AGENT%. Dang kill de khoi dong sach se...
        taskkill /F /PID %%p >nul 2>&1
        timeout /t 1 >nul
    )
)

echo ==========================================
echo   Dang khoi dong Fingerprint Agent...
echo ==========================================
echo.

python agent.py

echo.
echo Agent da dung.
pause
exit /b 0

    <script>
      (function() {
        try {
          const theme = localStorage.getItem('qk7_theme') || 'dark';
          if (theme === 'dark') {
            document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
          } else {
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
            document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      })();
    </script>
  </head>
  <body class="h-full bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-950 dark:text-slate-100 transition-colors duration-200">
    <div id="root"></div>
    <script type="module" src="/src/main.tsx"></script>
  </body>

import React from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ConfigProvider, App as AntApp, theme as antdTheme } from 'antd';
import viVN from 'antd/locale/vi_VN';
import { ThemeProvider, useTheme } from './contexts/ThemeContext';
import { DeviceModeProvider } from './contexts/DeviceModeContext';
import { AuthProvider } from './contexts/AuthContext'; // ✅ bỏ useAuth (không dùng)
import { RouterProvider } from './routes/RouterProvider';
import { HttpErrorListener } from './components/common/HttpErrorListener';
import { ApprovalListener } from './components/common/ApprovalListener';
import { ToastProvider } from './components/common/Toast';
import { NetworkStatusProvider } from './contexts/NetworkStatusContext';
import AIChatDrawer from './components/ai-chat/AIChatDrawer';
import { ApprovalProvider } from './contexts/ApprovalContext';
import { AIChatProvider } from './contexts/AIChatContext'
import './index.css';

/**
 * Wrapper đồng bộ Theme (Dark/Light) và Cấu hình Token Ant Design toàn diện
 * - Màu action chính: Xanh Lục Quân (#166534 / #10b981) & Vàng Kim Quân Hiệu (#b45309 / #fbbf24)
 * - Nền tối chuẩn Quân sự SOC: #090e17 (Base), #111827 (Surface/Card/Table)
 * - Locale: Tiếng Việt (vi_VN)
 * - AntApp cung cấp static context cho message, notification, modal
 */
const AntdAppWrapper: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  return (
    <ConfigProvider
      locale={viVN}
      theme={{
        algorithm: isDark ? antdTheme.darkAlgorithm : antdTheme.defaultAlgorithm,
        token: {
          colorPrimary: isDark ? '#10b981' : '#166534', // Xanh Lục Quân chuẩn Quân đội Nhân dân VN
          colorPrimaryHover: isDark ? '#059669' : '#14532d',
          colorPrimaryActive: isDark ? '#047857' : '#15803d',
          colorLink: isDark ? '#34d399' : '#166534',
          colorLinkHover: isDark ? '#6ee7b7' : '#15803d',
          borderRadius: 8,
          fontFamily: `'Be Vietnam Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif`,
          // Phân lớp bề mặt Dark/Light Mode chuẩn Quân đội & SOC
          ...(isDark
            ? {
                colorBgBase: '#090e17',
                colorBgContainer: '#111827',
                colorBgElevated: '#1e293b',
                colorBgLayout: '#090e17',
                colorTextBase: '#f1f5f9',
                colorTextSecondary: '#94a3b8',
                colorBorder: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)',
                colorBorderSecondary: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)',
              }
            : {
                colorBgBase: '#f8fafc',
                colorBgContainer: '#ffffff',
                colorBgElevated: '#ffffff',
                colorBgLayout: '#f8fafc',
                colorTextBase: '#0f172a',
                colorTextSecondary: '#64748b',
                colorBorder: '#e2e8f0',
                colorBorderSecondary: '#f1f5f9',
              }),
        },
        components: {
          Button: {
            controlHeight: 38,
            borderRadius: 8,
            primaryShadow: isDark ? '0 4px 12px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)' : '0 4px 12px rgba(22, 101, 52, 0.25)',
          },
          Input: {
            controlHeight: 38,
            borderRadius: 8,
            colorBgContainer: isDark ? '#111827' : '#ffffff',
            colorBorder: isDark ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)' : '#cbd5e1',
          },
          Select: {
            controlHeight: 38,
            borderRadius: 8,
            colorBgContainer: isDark ? '#111827' : '#ffffff',
            colorBorder: isDark ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)' : '#cbd5e1',
          },
          TreeSelect: {
            controlHeight: 38,
            borderRadius: 12,
            colorBgContainer: isDark ? '#111827' : '#ffffff',
          },
          Card: {
            borderRadiusLG: 12,
            colorBgContainer: isDark ? '#111827' : '#ffffff',
            colorBorderSecondary: isDark ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)' : '#e2e8f0',
          },
          Table: {
            borderRadiusLG: 8,
            colorBgContainer: isDark ? '#111827' : '#ffffff',
            headerBg: isDark ? '#0f172a' : '#f8fafc',
            headerColor: isDark ? '#e2e8f0' : '#475569',
            rowHoverBg: isDark ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)' : 'rgba(22, 101, 52, 0.06)',
            borderColor: isDark ? '#1e293b' : '#f1f5f9',
          },
          Modal: {
            borderRadiusLG: 12,
            contentBg: isDark ? '#111827' : '#ffffff',
            headerBg: isDark ? '#111827' : '#ffffff',
          },
          Drawer: {
            colorBgElevated: isDark ? '#111827' : '#ffffff',
          },
          Tag: {
            borderRadiusSM: 6,
          },
        },
      }}
    >
      <AntApp>
        <HttpErrorListener />
        <ApprovalListener />
        {children}
      </AntApp>
    </ConfigProvider>
  );
};

/**
 * Global AI Assistant Chat Wrapper
 * Đảm bảo hiển thị xuyên suốt trên mọi trang sau khi quân nhân đăng nhập
 * (Bao gồm cả Cổng Portal, Bàn làm việc Văn thư và Toàn bộ các trang Quản trị)
 */
const AIChatWrapper: React.FC = () => {
  const location = useLocation();

  // Không hiển thị trên trang đăng nhập
  if (location.pathname === '/login') {
    return null;
  }

  // Render AIChatDrawer hiện đại (Slide-over Drawer) kích hoạt từ nút Bot trên Header
  return <AIChatDrawer />;
};

/**
 * Root Application Component
 * Sets up global context providers (Theme, DeviceMode, Ant Design, Auth, AIChat) and BrowserRouter.
 * Route definitions are fully delegated to RouterProvider (auto-discovered routes).
 */
export const App: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <ThemeProvider>
        <DeviceModeProvider>
          <AntdAppWrapper>
            <ToastProvider>
              <NetworkStatusProvider>
                <AuthProvider>
                  <AIChatProvider>
                    <ApprovalProvider pollMs={0}>
                      <RouterProvider />
                      <AIChatWrapper />
                    </ApprovalProvider>
                  </AIChatProvider>
                </AuthProvider>
              </NetworkStatusProvider>
            </ToastProvider>
          </AntdAppWrapper>
        </DeviceModeProvider>
      </ThemeProvider>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
};

export default App;

/**
 * HTTP Client Wrapper dùng chung cho toàn bộ frontend.
 *
 * Cơ chế xác thực:
 *   - FE gửi duy nhất: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (qua getAuthHeaders())
 *   - Backend Express (:8000) verify JWT và tự inject X-User-Id / X-Clearance
 *     khi proxy sang AI microservice (:8001) — FE KHÔNG được tự set các header này
 *     để tránh giả mạo quyền hạn.
 *
 * Response lỗi (401, 403, 5xx) sẽ phát sự kiện `qk7:http-error` để
 * HttpErrorListener (mounted toàn cục) hiển thị notification + điều hướng.
 */

export interface HttpOptions extends RequestInit {
  skipErrorNotification?: boolean;
  autoRedirectOnError?: boolean;
  silent?: boolean;
}

export interface HttpErrorDetail {
  status: number;
  message: string;
  url: string;
  data?: any;
  autoRedirect?: boolean;
}

export class HttpError extends Error {
  status: number;
  data: any;
  url: string;

  constructor(status: number, message: string, data?: any, url: string = '') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'HttpError';
    this.status = status;
    this.data = data;
    this.url = url;
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, HttpError.prototype);
  }
}

export function getAuthHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
  const token = sessionStorage.getItem('qk7_token');
  if (token) {
    return { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` };
  }
  return {};
}

export async function http<T>(url: string, options: HttpOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  const headers = {
    ...getAuthHeaders(),
    ...(options.headers || {}),
  };

  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      ...options,
      headers,
    });

    const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
    let data: any = null;
    if (contentType.includes('application/json')) {
      data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    } else {
      data = await response.text();
    }


    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // [v4.3.2] 202 APPROVAL_REQUIRED — không phải lỗi, chỉ "chờ duyệt"
    // Dispatch event để ApprovalListener toast toàn cục.
    // Caller PHẢI check isApprovalRequired() để tránh show success sai.
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    if (
      response.status === 202 &&
      typeof data === 'object' &&
      (data as any)?.code === 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED'
    ) {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && !options.skipErrorNotification) {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent('qk7:approval-required', { detail: data })
        );
      }
      return data as T;
    }


    if (!response.ok) {
      let errorMsg = `Lỗi HTTP ${response.status}`;
      if (typeof data === 'object' && data?.error) {
        errorMsg = data.error;
      } else if (typeof data === 'string' && data.trim()) {
        const preMatch = data.match(/<pre>(.*?)<\/pre>/is);
        if (preMatch) {
          errorMsg = preMatch[1].trim();
        } else if (data.includes('<!DOCTYPE') || data.includes('<html')) {
          errorMsg = `Lỗi máy chủ (${response.status})`;
        } else {
          errorMsg = data.trim();
        }
      } else if (response.status === 500 || response.status === 502 || response.status === 504) {
        errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ backend (Port 8000). Vui lòng đảm bảo backend đang chạy!';
      }

      const httpError = new HttpError(response.status, errorMsg, data, url);
      if (!options.silent && import.meta.env.DEV) {
        console.error(`[HTTP ${response.status}] ${options.method || 'GET'} ${url.split('?')[0]}`);
      }

      // Kích hoạt custom event toàn cục để Router/App lắng nghe và điều hướng
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && !options.skipErrorNotification) {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent<HttpErrorDetail>('qk7:http-error', {
            detail: {
              status: response.status,
              message: errorMsg,
              url,
              data,
              autoRedirect: options.autoRedirectOnError ?? false,
            },
          })
        );
      }

      throw httpError;
    }

    return data as T;
  } catch (err: any) {
    // Nếu là lỗi mạng không phản hồi (fetch failed/offline/Safari Load failed)
    if (!(err instanceof HttpError)) {
      const isLoadFailed =
        err?.name === 'TypeError' ||
        err?.message === 'Load failed' ||
        (err?.message && (err.message.includes('fetch') || err.message.includes('Load failed')));

      const friendlyMsg = isLoadFailed
        ? 'Không thể kết nối đến máy chủ backend (Port 8000). Vui lòng đảm bảo backend đang chạy!'
        : (err.message || 'Mất kết nối tới máy chủ');

      const netError = new HttpError(503, friendlyMsg, null, url);
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && !options.skipErrorNotification) {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent<HttpErrorDetail>('qk7:http-error', {
            detail: {
              status: 503,
              message: friendlyMsg,
              url,
              autoRedirect: options.autoRedirectOnError ?? false,
            },
          })
        );
      }
      throw netError;
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Gọi API backend để test phản hồi mã trạng thái HTTP thực tế
 */
export async function testBackendHttpError(code: number, message?: string): Promise<any> {
  const query = message ? `?msg=${encodeURIComponent(message)}` : '';
  return http(`/api/test-http-error/${code}${query}`, { skipErrorNotification: false });
}

import { http } from '../services/http';
import { API_ENDPOINTS } from '../constants/apiEndpoints';
import { User } from '../types/user';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Storage Keys
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const STORAGE_KEYS = {
  TOKEN: 'qk7_token',
  EXPIRES_IN: 'qk7_token_expires',
  USER: 'qk7_user',
  USERNAME: 'qk7_username',
  USER_LOGIN: 'qk7_user_login',
  NAME: 'qk7_name',
  LEVEL: 'qk7_level',
  UNIT: 'qk7_unit',
  UNIT_NAME: 'qk7_unit_name',
  POSITION: 'qk7_position',
  RANK: 'qk7_rank',
  CLEARANCE_NAME: 'qk7_clearance_name',
  CLEARANCE_CODE: 'qk7_clearance_code',
  STATUS: 'qk7_status',
  ROLES: 'qk7_roles',
  ROLE_NAMES: 'qk7_role_names',
  PERMISSIONS: 'qk7_permissions',
} as const;

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Response Interfaces
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export interface LoginResponse {
  success: boolean;
  token: string;
  expires_in: string;   // "8h", "1d"...
  user: User;
}

export interface JwtPayload {
  user_id: string;
  clearance_level_id: number;
  roles: string[];
  iat: number;
  exp: number;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Helpers
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Parse JWT payload mà không cần verify chữ ký.
 * KHÔNG dùng để quyết định phân quyền — chỉ để hiển thị / optimistic UI.
 */
function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): JwtPayload | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const base64Url = parts[1];
    const base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const padded = base64 + '='.repeat((4 - (base64.length % 4)) % 4);
    const json = decodeURIComponent(
      atob(padded)
        .split('')
        .map((c) => '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2))
        .join(''),
    );
    return JSON.parse(json) as JwtPayload;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Chuyển "8h"/"1d"/"30m" thành milliseconds. Trả 0 nếu không parse được.
 */
function parseExpiresIn(value: string | undefined): number {
  if (!value) return 0;
  const match = value.match(/^(\d+)\s*([smhd])$/i);
  if (!match) return 0;
  const n = parseInt(match[1], 10);
  const unit = match[2].toLowerCase();
  const multipliers: Record<string, number> = {
    s: 1000,
    m: 60 * 1000,
    h: 60 * 60 * 1000,
    d: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
  };
  return n * (multipliers[unit] || 0);
}

/**
 * Ghi nếu có giá trị, xoá nếu undefined/rỗng — tránh stale data từ user cũ.
 */
function writeOrClear(key: string, value: string | undefined | null): void {
  if (value != null && value !== '') {
    sessionStorage.setItem(key, value);
  } else {
    sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
  }
}

/**
 * Ghi mảng string dạng JSON nếu hợp lệ, xoá key nếu undefined.
 * Phân biệt: `undefined` (chưa biết) ≠ `[]` (đã biết rỗng).
 */
function writeJsonArray(key: string, value: string[] | undefined): void {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
  } else {
    sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
  }
}

/**
 * Đọc mảng string dạng JSON. Trả undefined nếu không có hoặc hỏng.
 */
function readJsonArray(key: string): string[] | undefined {
  const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(key);
  if (!raw) return undefined;
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(v) && v.every((x) => typeof x === 'string')
      ? (v as string[])
      : undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Auth Service
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export const authService = {
  /**
   * Đăng nhập — lưu JWT token + user info vào sessionStorage.
   *
   * ⚠️ FAIL-FAST: nếu backend không trả token, hoặc sessionStorage không
   * ghi được (Ẩn danh / storage bị chặn) → THROW để AuthContext biết
   * login THẤT BẠI — tránh trạng thái "login ảo".
   */
  login: async (user_id: string, password: string): Promise<any> => { // Đổi return type thành any để linh hoạt
    const res = await http<any>(API_ENDPOINTS.AUTH.LOGIN, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: user_id.trim(), password }),
    });

    // Trả về ngay để LoginForm mở Modal quét vân tay
    if (res?.require_admin_fp) {
      return res;
    }

    // ─── 1. Backend phải trả token (cho User thường) ───
    if (!res?.token) {
      authService.clearSession();
      throw new Error(
        'Máy chủ không trả về token xác thực. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên hệ thống.',
      );
    }

    // ─── 2. Lưu token — THROW nếu thất bại ───
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TOKEN, res.token);
      try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TOKEN, res.token); } catch (_) {}

      const ttlMs = parseExpiresIn(res.expires_in);
      if (ttlMs > 0) {
        sessionStorage.setItem(
          STORAGE_KEYS.EXPIRES_IN,
          String(Date.now() + ttlMs),
        );
      }

      // Verify round-trip (belt-and-suspenders)
      const verifyToken = sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TOKEN);
      if (!verifyToken || verifyToken !== res.token) {
        throw new Error('TOKEN_NOT_PERSISTED');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      authService.clearSession();
      if (e?.message === 'TOKEN_NOT_PERSISTED') {
        throw new Error(
          'Phiên đăng nhập không được lưu trữ. Trình duyệt có thể đang chặn sessionStorage.',
        );
      }
      throw new Error(
        'Trình duyệt không cho phép lưu phiên đăng nhập (có thể do chế độ Ẩn danh). ' +
          'Vui lòng tắt chế độ Ẩn danh hoặc cho phép lưu trữ trang này rồi đăng nhập lại.',
      );
    }

    return res;
  },

  /**
   * Lấy thông tin user hiện tại từ server (dùng JWT trong header).
   * Luôn chuẩn hoá về `User` với `roles/role_names/permissions` là mảng
   * (không undefined) — vì đây là nguồn chân lý.
   */
  getMe: async (): Promise<User> => {
    const res = await http<any>(API_ENDPOINTS.AUTH.ME);
    const raw: any = res && res.user ? res.user : res;
    return {
      ...raw,
      roles: Array.isArray(raw?.roles) ? raw.roles : [],
      role_names: Array.isArray(raw?.role_names) ? raw.role_names : [],
      permissions: Array.isArray(raw?.permissions) ? raw.permissions : [],
    } as User;
  },

  /** Lấy JWT token hiện tại. */
  getToken: (): string | null => {
    try {
      return sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TOKEN);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },

  /** Đã có token và còn hạn không. */
  hasValidToken: (): boolean => {
    const token = authService.getToken();
    if (!token) return false;
    return !authService.isTokenExpired(0);
  },

  /** Decode JWT payload — chỉ dùng cho optimistic UI. */
  getTokenPayload: (): JwtPayload | null => {
    const token = authService.getToken();
    if (!token) return null;
    return decodeJwtPayload(token);
  },

  /**
   * Token hết hạn chưa (dựa trên `exp` hoặc fallback `expires_at`).
   */
  isTokenExpired: (bufferSeconds = 30): boolean => {
    const token = authService.getToken();
    if (!token) return true;

    const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
    if (payload && typeof payload.exp === 'number') {
      return Date.now() + bufferSeconds * 1000 >= payload.exp * 1000;
    }

    const expiresAt = sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.EXPIRES_IN);
    if (expiresAt) {
      const ts = parseInt(expiresAt, 10);
      if (!isNaN(ts)) return Date.now() + bufferSeconds * 1000 >= ts;
    }

    return false;
  },

  /**
   * Lưu user info vào sessionStorage.
   *
   * Ghi cả JSON blob (`qk7_user`) — dùng làm nguồn chính khi F5 — VÀ
   * các key riêng lẻ để tương thích code cũ. Key nào `undefined` sẽ bị
   * XOÁ để tránh stale data.
   */
  saveSession: (user: User) => {
    // Xóa sạch token vân tay cũ khi lưu phiên đăng nhập mới
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('qk7_fp_token');
        Object.keys(sessionStorage).forEach((key) => {
          if (key.startsWith('qk7_fp_token')) {
            sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
          }
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // ─── Primary: full user JSON ───
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.USER, JSON.stringify(user));
      try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.USER, JSON.stringify(user)); } catch (_) {}
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[authService] Failed to serialize user to sessionStorage', e);
    }

    // ─── Legacy / explicit keys ───
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME, user.user_id);
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_LOGIN, user.username ?? user.user_id?.toLowerCase());
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.NAME, user.full_name);
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.LEVEL, String(user.clearance_level_id ?? ''));
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.UNIT, user.unit_id);
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.UNIT_NAME, user.unit_name);
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.POSITION, user.position);
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.RANK, user.rank_name);
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.CLEARANCE_NAME, user.clearance_name);
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.CLEARANCE_CODE, user.clearance_code);
    writeOrClear(STORAGE_KEYS.STATUS, user.status);

    // ⭐ Array fields: phân biệt undefined vs [] đúng chuẩn
    writeJsonArray(STORAGE_KEYS.ROLES, user.roles);
    writeJsonArray(STORAGE_KEYS.ROLE_NAMES, user.role_names);
    writeJsonArray(STORAGE_KEYS.PERMISSIONS, user.permissions);
  },

  /** Xoá toàn bộ session — logout / token hết hạn. */
  clearSession: () => {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TOKEN);
      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.USER);
    } catch (_) {}
    Object.values(STORAGE_KEYS).forEach((key) => {
      sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
    });
    // Xóa sạch toàn bộ token vân tay tài liệu còn lưu trong sessionStorage
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('qk7_fp_token');
        Object.keys(sessionStorage).forEach((key) => {
          if (key.startsWith('qk7_fp_token')) {
            sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
          }
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  },

  /**
   * Lấy user hiện tại từ sessionStorage (không gọi API).
   * Trả GUEST nếu chưa đăng nhập.
   *
   * ⚠️ Trả về permissions đúng trạng thái:
   *   - Có mảng: dùng luôn (fast path).
   *   - Undefined: AuthContext sẽ tự gọi `getMe()` để bù (slow path).
   *   - GUEST: `permissions: []` — không có quyền gì.
   */
  getCurrentSession: (): User => {
    // ─── 1. Primary: JSON blob ───
    const rawUser = sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.USER);
    if (rawUser) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawUser);
        if (parsed && parsed.user_id) {
          // Chuẩn hoá: JSON.stringify đã bỏ key undefined → có thể thiếu.
          // Không set mặc định ở đây để AuthContext phân biệt được
          // "undefined" (chưa biết) vs "[]" (đã biết rỗng).
          return {
            ...parsed,
            roles: parsed.roles,
            role_names: parsed.role_names,
            permissions: parsed.permissions,
          } as User;
        }
      } catch {
        // rơi xuống fallback
      }
    }

    // ─── 2. Fallback: GUEST ───
    const userId = sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME);
    if (!userId || userId === 'GUEST') {
      return {
        user_id: 'GUEST',
        full_name: 'Đại biểu',
        clearance_level_id: 1,
        clearance_name: 'Công khai',
        roles: [],
        role_names: [],
        permissions: [],
      };
    }

    // ─── 3. Fallback: đọc từng key (JSON blob hỏng) ───
    return {
      user_id: userId,
      username:
        sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_LOGIN) || userId.toLowerCase(),
      full_name: sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.NAME) || userId,
      clearance_level_id: parseInt(
        sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LEVEL) || '1',
        10,
      ),
      unit_id: sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.UNIT) || undefined,
      unit_name: sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.UNIT_NAME) || undefined,
      position: sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.POSITION) || undefined,
      rank_name: sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.RANK) || undefined,
      clearance_name:
        sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CLEARANCE_NAME) || undefined,
      clearance_code:
        sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CLEARANCE_CODE) || undefined,
      status: sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.STATUS) || 'active',
      roles: readJsonArray(STORAGE_KEYS.ROLES),
      role_names: readJsonArray(STORAGE_KEYS.ROLE_NAMES),
      permissions: readJsonArray(STORAGE_KEYS.PERMISSIONS), // ⭐ NEW
    };
  },

  /**
   * Logout — gọi backend revoke session, sau đó clear local.
   * Backend lỗi vẫn phải clear local để user không bị treo.
   */
  logout: async (): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      await http(API_ENDPOINTS.AUTH.LOGOUT, {
        method: 'POST',
        skipErrorNotification: true,
        silent: true,
      });
    } catch {
      // ignore
    } finally {
      authService.clearSession();
    }
  },
};

import { http } from './http';
import { systemService } from './systemService';
import { roleService } from './roleService';
import { permissionService } from './permissionService';
import { unitService } from './unitService';
import { documentTypeService } from './documentTypeService';
import { securityLevelService } from './securityLevelService';
import { logService } from './logService';

import { http } from './http';
import { API_ENDPOINTS } from '../constants/apiEndpoints';
import { DocumentItem, DocumentFilterParams } from '../types/document';
import fileService from './fileService';


export interface ParsedDocumentMetadata {
    document_code: string | null;
    document_number: string | null;
    doc_type_code: string | null;
    doc_type_name: string | null;
    title: string | null;
    issued_date: string | null;
    signer: string | null;
    signer_position: string | null;
    issuer_unit_name: string | null;
    issuer_parent_unit_name: string | null;  
    issuer_parent_unit_id: string | null;       
    issuer_unit_id: string | null;            
    issuer_display: string | null;              
    parent_matched: boolean;           
    unit_matched: boolean;
}

export interface ParseDocumentResult {
    success: boolean;
    source: 'digital' | 'scan';
    usedOcr: boolean;
    missingFields: string[];
    parsed: ParsedDocumentMetadata;
    sources: Record<string, string>;
    original_name?: string;
    file_size?: number;
    sha256?: string;
    error?: string;
    duplicate_check?: CheckDuplicateResult;
    classification?: {
        pdfType: 'TextBased' | 'Scanned' | 'Mixed';
        totalPages: number;
        pagesNeedingOcr: number[];
        elapsedMs: number;
    };
    ocr_engine?: string;
    total_duration_ms?: number;
}

/**
 * Check duplicate document based on SHA256 and document code
 */
export interface DuplicateMatchDoc {
  file_id: string;
  document_code?: string | null;
  title: string;
  security_level_id: number;
  security_name?: string;
  created_at?: string;
  uploaded_by?: string;
  uploaded_by_name?: string;
}

export interface CheckDuplicateResult {
  sha256: string;
  is_duplicate: boolean;
  sha_duplicate: boolean;
  code_duplicate: boolean;
  matches: {
    by_sha256: DuplicateMatchDoc[];
    by_code: DuplicateMatchDoc[];
  };
}


export interface MyUnitDocumentResponse {
  total: number;
  items: DocumentItem[];
  unit: { unit_id: string; name: string; parent_id?: string | null };
  subtree_unit_ids: string[];
  can_select_unit: boolean;
  selected_unit_id: string;
}

export interface MyUnitDocumentParams {
  unit_id?: string;
  q?: string;
  code?: string;
  title?: string;
  type?: string;
  from?: string;
  to?: string;
  lv?: number;
}


/**
 * Document Service — Quản lý tìm kiếm, tra cứu, tải lên và số hóa văn bản
 */
export const documentService = {
  getDocuments: async (
    params: DocumentFilterParams = {}
  ): Promise<{ total: number; items: DocumentItem[] }> => {
    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.q) searchParams.append('q', params.q);
    if (params.code) searchParams.append('code', params.code);
    if (params.title) searchParams.append('title', params.title);
    const type = params.type || params.doc_type_id;
    if (type) searchParams.append('type', type);
    const unit = params.unit || params.issuing_unit_id;
    if (unit) searchParams.append('unit', unit);
    if (params.include_children) searchParams.append('include_children', 'true');
    if (params.from) searchParams.append('from', params.from);
    if (params.to) searchParams.append('to', params.to);
    const lv = params.lv ?? params.security_level_id;
    if (lv !== undefined && lv !== null && lv !== '') searchParams.append('lv', String(lv));

    const qs = searchParams.toString();
    return http<{ total: number; items: DocumentItem[] }>(
      `${API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.LIST}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`
    );
  },

  getDocumentById: async (fileId: string): Promise<DocumentItem> => {
    return http<DocumentItem>(API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.DETAIL(fileId));
  },

    getMyUnitDocuments: async (
    params: MyUnitDocumentParams = {}
  ): Promise<MyUnitDocumentResponse> => {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.unit_id) sp.append('unit_id', params.unit_id);
    if (params.q) sp.append('q', params.q);
    if (params.code) sp.append('code', params.code);
    if (params.title) sp.append('title', params.title);
    if (params.type) sp.append('type', params.type);
    if (params.from) sp.append('from', params.from);
    if (params.to) sp.append('to', params.to);
    if (params.lv !== undefined && params.lv !== null) sp.append('lv', String(params.lv));

    const qs = sp.toString();
    return http<MyUnitDocumentResponse>(
      `${API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.MY_UNIT}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`, 
      { skipErrorNotification: true }
    );
  },

  uploadDocument: async (
    formData: FormData
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; file_id: string; stored_path: string; sha256: string }> => {
    return http(API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.UPLOAD, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: formData,
    });
  },


  /**
 * @deprecated Từ v2026.10, dùng `parseDocument()` — API parse đã trả về
 * `duplicate_check` (SHA-256 + document_code) trong cùng 1 request,
 * tránh 2 round-trip. Hàm này chỉ giữ để tương thích ngược với code cũ.
 *
 * Check for duplicate documents based on SHA256 and document code
 */
  checkDuplicate: async (
    file: File,
    documentCode?: string
  ): Promise<CheckDuplicateResult> => {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);
    if (documentCode) formData.append('document_code', documentCode);

    return http<CheckDuplicateResult>('/api/documents/check-duplicate', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: formData,
      skipErrorNotification: true,
    });
  },


  /**
   * Parse PDF → metadata (không lưu file, không ghi DB)
   */
  parseDocument: async (file: File): Promise<ParseDocumentResult> => {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);
    return http<ParseDocumentResult>(API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.PARSE, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: formData,
    });
  },

  updateDocument: async (
    fileId: string,
    formData: FormData
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; file_id: string; replaced_file: boolean; stored_path: string }> => {
    return http(API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.UPDATE(fileId), {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: formData,
    });
  },

  deleteDocument: async (fileId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; file_id: string }> => {
    return http(API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.DELETE(fileId), {
      method: 'DELETE',
    });
  },

  getViewUrl: fileService.getViewUrl,
  fetchDocumentBlob: fileService.fetchFileBlob,
  downloadDocument: fileService.downloadFile,
  saveBlobToFile: fileService.saveBlobToFile,
  prepareDownload: fileService.prepareDownload,

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // SOFT DELETE / TRASH / RESTORE / PURGE
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  getTrash: async (): Promise<{ total: number; items: DocumentItem[] }> => {
    return http<{ total: number; items: DocumentItem[] }>(API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.TRASH);
  },

  restoreDocument: async (
    fileId: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; file_id: string; restored: boolean }> => {
    return http(API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.RESTORE(fileId), { method: 'POST' });
  },

  purgeDocument: async (
    fileId: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; file_id: string; purged: boolean }> => {
    return http(API_ENDPOINTS.DOCUMENTS.PURGE(fileId), {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ confirm: fileId }),
    });
  },

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // DOCUMENT REVISION PROPOSALS (Đề xuất sửa đổi chờ duyệt)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  getPendingProposals: async (): Promise<{ total: number; items: any[] }> => {
    return http<{ total: number; items: any[] }>('/api/documents/proposals/pending');
  },

  approveProposal: async (
    proposalId: string,
    reviewNote?: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> => {
    return http<{ success: boolean; message: string }>(
      `/api/documents/proposals/${encodeURIComponent(proposalId)}/approve`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ review_note: reviewNote }),
      }
    );
  },

  rejectProposal: async (
    proposalId: string,
    reason?: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> => {
    return http<{ success: boolean; message: string }>(
      `/api/documents/proposals/${encodeURIComponent(proposalId)}/reject`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
      }
    );
  },


};

File: frontend/src/services/fileService.ts
