import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import * as pdfjsLib from 'pdfjs-dist';
import pdfWorker from 'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url';
import 'pdfjs-dist/web/pdf_viewer.css';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = pdfWorker;

const EMPTY_STROKES: HighlighterStroke[] = [];

export interface HighlighterStroke {
  color: string;
  width: number;
  points: { x: number; y: number }[];
}

export interface PdfPagesViewerProps {
  blobUrl: string;
  fileId: string;
  securityLevel?: number;
  isHighlighterActive: boolean;
  highlighterColor: string;
  onStrokeCountChange?: (count: number) => void;
  highlighterRef?: React.MutableRefObject<{ undo: () => void; clear: () => void; getStrokeCount: () => number } | null>;
}

export const PdfPagesViewer: React.FC<PdfPagesViewerProps> = React.memo(({
  blobUrl,
  fileId,
  securityLevel = 1,
  isHighlighterActive,
  highlighterColor,
  onStrokeCountChange,
  highlighterRef,
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [numPages, setNumPages] = useState<number>(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [pageDimensions, setPageDimensions] = useState<{ width: number; height: number }[]>([]);
  
  // Lưu trữ nét vẽ theo từng trang: Map<pageNumber, HighlighterStroke[]>
  const [pageStrokes, setPageStrokes] = useState<Record<number, HighlighterStroke[]>>({});

  const storageKey = `qk7_pdf_highlighter_${fileId}`;
  const isHighSecurity = securityLevel >= 3;

  // Load nét vẽ từ localStorage
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        setPageStrokes(parsed);
        const total = (Object.values(parsed) as any[]).reduce((sum: number, list: any) => sum + (list?.length || 0), 0);
        onStrokeCountChange?.(total);
      } else {
        setPageStrokes({});
        onStrokeCountChange?.(0);
      }
    } catch {
      setPageStrokes({});
      onStrokeCountChange?.(0);
    }
  }, [fileId, storageKey, onStrokeCountChange]);

  // Expose Undo và Clear cho thanh công cụ
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!highlighterRef) return;
    highlighterRef.current = {
      undo: () => {
        setPageStrokes((prev) => {
          const pageNums = Object.keys(prev).map(Number).sort((a, b) => b - a);
          for (const p of pageNums) {
            const list = prev[p];
            if (list && list.length > 0) {
              const newList = [...list];
              newList.pop();
              const nextState = { ...prev, [p]: newList };
              try {
                localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(nextState));
              } catch (_) {}
              const total = (Object.values(nextState) as any[]).reduce((sum: number, l: any) => sum + (l?.length || 0), 0);
              onStrokeCountChange?.(total);
              return nextState;
            }
          }
          return prev;
        });
      },
      clear: () => {
        setPageStrokes({});
        try {
          localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
        } catch (_) {}
        onStrokeCountChange?.(0);
      },
      getStrokeCount: () => {
        return (Object.values(pageStrokes) as any[]).reduce((sum: number, list: any) => sum + (list?.length || 0), 0);
      },
    };
  }, [highlighterRef, pageStrokes, storageKey, onStrokeCountChange]);

  // Phím tắt Ctrl + Z để Hoàn tác
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && (e.key === 'z' || e.key === 'Z') && !e.shiftKey) {
        if (highlighterRef?.current) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          highlighterRef.current.undo();
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, true);
  }, [highlighterRef]);

  // Tải PDF bằng pdfjsLib
  const pdfDocRef = useRef<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);

    (async () => {
      try {
        const loadingTask = pdfjsLib.getDocument({
          url: blobUrl,
          cMapUrl: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@4.3.136/cmaps/',
          cMapPacked: true,
        });
        const doc = await loadingTask.promise;
        if (isCancelled) return;

        pdfDocRef.current = doc;
        setNumPages(doc.numPages);

        // Lấy kích thước trang
        const dims: { width: number; height: number }[] = [];
        for (let i = 1; i <= doc.numPages; i++) {
          const page = await doc.getPage(i);
          const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: 1.0 });
          dims.push({ width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height });
        }
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setPageDimensions(dims);
          setLoading(false);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[PdfPagesViewer] Error loading document with pdfjs:', err);
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
    };
  }, [blobUrl]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`w-full h-full overflow-y-auto bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 flex flex-col items-center py-6 px-2 sm:px-4 relative transition-colors ${
        isHighSecurity ? 'select-none' : 'select-text'
      }`}
      style={{
        scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
      }}
    >
      <style>{`
        .textLayer {
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
          overflow: hidden;
          opacity: 1;
          line-height: 1;
          -webkit-text-size-adjust: none;
          text-size-adjust: none;
          forced-color-adjust: none;
          transform-origin: 0 0;
          z-index: 10;
        }
        .textLayer :is(span, br) {
          color: transparent;
          position: absolute;
          white-space: pre;
          cursor: text;
          transform-origin: 0% 0%;
        }
        .textLayer ::selection {
          background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.45) !important;
          color: transparent !important;
        }
        .textLayer ::-moz-selection {
          background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.45) !important;
          color: transparent !important;
        }
      `}</style>

      {loading && (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-slate-300 space-y-3 my-auto">
          <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-emerald-500" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium">Đang khởi tạo hiển thị trang văn bản chất lượng cao...</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {!loading && numPages > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center space-y-6 w-full max-w-4xl">
          {Array.from({ length: numPages }, (_, index) => {
            const pageNum = index + 1;
            const originalDim = pageDimensions[index] || { width: 595, height: 842 };
            return (
              <SinglePdfPage
                key={`pdf-page-${pageNum}`}
                pdfDoc={pdfDocRef.current}
                pageNum={pageNum}
                securityLevel={securityLevel}
                originalWidth={originalDim.width}
                originalHeight={originalDim.height}
                isHighlighterActive={isHighlighterActive}
                highlighterColor={highlighterColor}
                strokes={pageStrokes[pageNum] || EMPTY_STROKES}
                onSaveStroke={(newStroke) => {
                  setPageStrokes((prev) => {
                    const currentList = prev[pageNum] || EMPTY_STROKES;
                    const nextList = [...currentList, newStroke];
                    const nextState = { ...prev, [pageNum]: nextList };
                    try {
                      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(nextState));
                    } catch (_) {}
                    const total = (Object.values(nextState) as any[]).reduce((sum: number, l: any) => sum + (l?.length || 0), 0);
                    onStrokeCountChange?.(total);
                    return nextState;
                  });
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

interface SinglePdfPageProps {
  pdfDoc: any;
  pageNum: number;
  securityLevel: number;
  originalWidth: number;
  originalHeight: number;
  isHighlighterActive: boolean;
  highlighterColor: string;
  strokes: HighlighterStroke[];
  onSaveStroke: (stroke: HighlighterStroke) => void;
}

const SinglePdfPage: React.FC<SinglePdfPageProps> = React.memo(({
  pdfDoc,
  pageNum,
  securityLevel,
  originalWidth,
  originalHeight,
  isHighlighterActive,
  highlighterColor,
  strokes,
  onSaveStroke,
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pdfCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const textLayerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const highlightCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const [displayWidth, setDisplayWidth] = useState<number>(originalWidth);
  const [displayHeight, setDisplayHeight] = useState<number>(originalHeight);

  const isLowSecurity = securityLevel <= 2; // Cấp 1 Công khai & Cấp 2 Nội bộ

  // Vẽ lại toàn bộ strokes của trang này lên highlightCanvas
  const redrawStrokes = useCallback(() => {
    const canvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.restore();

    strokes.forEach((stroke) => {
      if (!stroke.points || stroke.points.length === 0) return;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.42;
      ctx.strokeStyle = stroke.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = stroke.width;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

      ctx.beginPath();
      const p0 = stroke.points[0];
      ctx.moveTo(p0.x, p0.y);

      if (stroke.points.length === 1) {
        ctx.lineTo(p0.x + 0.1, p0.y + 0.1);
      } else {
        for (let i = 1; i < stroke.points.length; i++) {
          const p = stroke.points[i];
          ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
        }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    });
  }, [strokes]);

  // Render trang PDF và TextLayer bằng pdf.js
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pdfDoc) return;
    let renderTask: any = null;

    (async () => {
      try {
        const page = await pdfDoc.getPage(pageNum);
        const parentWidth = containerRef.current?.parentElement?.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const targetWidth = Math.min(880, Math.max(360, parentWidth - 48));
        const scale = targetWidth / originalWidth;
        const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale });

        const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);

        setDisplayWidth(viewport.width);
        setDisplayHeight(viewport.height);

        // 1. Render Canvas PDF
        const pdfCanvas = pdfCanvasRef.current;
        if (pdfCanvas) {
          pdfCanvas.width = viewport.width * dpr;
          pdfCanvas.height = viewport.height * dpr;
          pdfCanvas.style.width = `${viewport.width}px`;
          pdfCanvas.style.height = `${viewport.height}px`;

          const ctx = pdfCanvas.getContext('2d');
          if (ctx) {
            ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
            renderTask = page.render({
              canvasContext: ctx,
              viewport: viewport,
            });
            await renderTask.promise;
          }
        }

        // 2. Render TextLayer (Cho phép bôi đen, sao chép Ctrl+C, chuột phải ở Cấp 1 & 2)
        const textContainer = textLayerRef.current;
        if (textContainer && isLowSecurity) {
          textContainer.innerHTML = '';
          textContainer.style.width = `${viewport.width}px`;
          textContainer.style.height = `${viewport.height}px`;
          textContainer.style.setProperty('--scale-factor', `${viewport.scale}`);

          const textContent = await page.getTextContent();
          const textLayer = new (pdfjsLib as any).TextLayer({
            textContentSource: textContent,
            container: textContainer,
            viewport: viewport,
          });
          await textLayer.render();
        }

        // 3. Chuẩn bị Canvas Highlight
        const hlCanvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
        if (hlCanvas) {
          hlCanvas.width = viewport.width * dpr;
          hlCanvas.height = viewport.height * dpr;
          hlCanvas.style.width = `${viewport.width}px`;
          hlCanvas.style.height = `${viewport.height}px`;

          const hlCtx = hlCanvas.getContext('2d');
          if (hlCtx) {
            hlCtx.scale(dpr, dpr);
          }
          redrawStrokes();
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (e.name !== 'RenderingCancelledException') {
          console.warn(`[Page ${pageNum}] Render error:`, e);
        }
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      if (renderTask) {
        try {
          renderTask.cancel();
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    };
  }, [pdfDoc, pageNum, originalWidth, originalHeight, isLowSecurity]);

  // Vẽ lại khi strokes thay đổi
  useEffect(() => {
    redrawStrokes();
  }, [redrawStrokes]);

  // Thao tác vẽ bút dạ quang trên trang này
  const isDrawingRef = useRef(false);
  const currentPointsRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number }[]>([]);

  const getPos = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const canvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: e.clientX - rect.left,
      y: e.clientY - rect.top,
    };
  };

  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!isHighlighterActive) return;
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    isDrawingRef.current = true;
    const pos = getPos(e);
    currentPointsRef.current = [pos];

    const canvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.42;
    ctx.strokeStyle = highlighterColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 20;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pos.x, pos.y);
    ctx.lineTo(pos.x + 0.1, pos.y + 0.1);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!isHighlighterActive || !isDrawingRef.current) return;
    const pos = getPos(e);
    const pts = currentPointsRef.current;
    const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
    if (Math.hypot(pos.x - last.x, pos.y - last.y) < 2) return;

    pts.push(pos);

    const canvas = highlightCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.42;
    ctx.strokeStyle = highlighterColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 20;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(last.x, last.y);
    ctx.lineTo(pos.x, pos.y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!isHighlighterActive || !isDrawingRef.current) return;
    isDrawingRef.current = false;
    try {
      e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch (_) {}

    if (currentPointsRef.current.length > 0) {
      const newStroke: HighlighterStroke = {
        color: highlighterColor,
        width: 20,
        points: [...currentPointsRef.current],
      };
      currentPointsRef.current = [];
      onSaveStroke(newStroke);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`relative bg-white shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-slate-900/10 dark:ring-white/10 rounded-sm transition-transform duration-150 overflow-hidden ${
        isLowSecurity ? 'select-text' : 'select-none'
      }`}
      style={{
        width: displayWidth,
        height: displayHeight,
      }}
    >
      {/* 📄 Lớp 1: Canvas PDF hiển thị nét chữ & Watermark */}
      <canvas ref={pdfCanvasRef} className="block w-full h-full pointer-events-none select-none" />

      {/* 🔤 Lớp 2: TextLayer DOM (Cho phép bôi đen, sao chép Ctrl+C và dán Ctrl+V ở Cấp 1 & 2) */}
      {isLowSecurity && (
        <div
          ref={textLayerRef}
          className={`textLayer ${
            isHighlighterActive ? 'pointer-events-none select-none' : 'pointer-events-auto select-text'
          }`}
          style={{
            zIndex: 10,
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* 🖊️ Lớp 3: Canvas Bút dạ quang (ĂN CỨNG THEO TÀI LIỆU GIỐNG WATERMARK) */}
      <canvas
        ref={highlightCanvasRef}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
        onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
        onPointerCancel={handlePointerUp}
        className={`absolute inset-0 w-full h-full ${
          isHighlighterActive
            ? 'cursor-crosshair opacity-100 pointer-events-auto z-20'
            : 'pointer-events-none opacity-90 z-5'
        }`}
        style={{
          touchAction: isHighlighterActive ? 'none' : 'auto',
        }}
      />

      {/* Số trang góc dưới */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-2 right-3 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-medium text-slate-400 bg-slate-50/80 border border-slate-200 pointer-events-none z-20">
        Trang {pageNum}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { isUserAdmin } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';
import {
  X,
  Clock,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  FileText,
  Shield,
  Building,
  User,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  Calendar,
  MessageSquare,
  Sparkles,
  MinusCircle,
  PlusCircle,
  Check,
  Send,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { documentService } from '../../services/documentService';
import { toast } from '../common/Toast';
import { getInitials } from './ApprovalDiffModal';

export interface PendingProposalItem {
  proposal_id: string;
  file_id: string;
  requester_id: string;
  requester_name: string;
  requester_rank?: string;
  requester_position?: string;
  requester_unit_id?: string;
  requester_unit_name?: string;
  document_code?: string;
  title: string;
  doc_type_id?: string;
  issued_date?: string;
  issuing_unit_id?: string;
  issuing_unit_name?: string;
  signer?: string;
  summary?: string;
  security_level_id: number;
  security_level_name?: string;
  current_document_code?: string;
  current_title: string;
  current_signer?: string;
  current_security_level_id: number;
  current_security_name?: string;
  current_unit_name?: string;
  current_issued_date?: string;
  document_issuing_unit_id?: string;
  new_stored_path?: string;
  new_original_name?: string;
  new_file_size?: number;
  deleted_reason?: string;
  is_new_upload?: boolean;
  note?: string;
  created_at: string;
}

export interface PendingProposalsModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  proposals: PendingProposalItem[];
  canApprove: boolean; // Chỉ huy hoặc Admin
  onClose: () => void;
  onRefresh: () => void;
}

export const PendingProposalsModal: React.FC<PendingProposalsModalProps> = ({
  open,
  proposals,
  canApprove,
  onClose,
  onRefresh,
}) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  const [selectedProposal, setSelectedProposal] = useState<PendingProposalItem | null>(null);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [actionInputMode, setActionInputMode] = useState<'idle' | 'reject'>('idle');
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // DERIVED VALUES
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const activeItem = selectedProposal || (proposals.length > 0 ? proposals[0] : null);

  const isAdminRole =
    isUserAdmin(user) ||
    user?.user_id === 'USR-001' ||
    (user?.roles || []).includes('ROL-01');

  const isCommanderRole = (user?.roles || []).includes('ROL-02');
  const canSelfApprove = isAdminRole || isCommanderRole;

  const hasRealPermissionToApprove =
    canApprove && (isAdminRole || isCommanderRole);

  const isSelfRequest = activeItem?.requester_id === user?.user_id;
  const blockSelfApprove = isSelfRequest && !canSelfApprove;

  const isInternalUnit = Boolean(
    user?.unit_id &&
      activeItem &&
      (activeItem.issuing_unit_id === user.unit_id ||
        activeItem.document_issuing_unit_id === user.unit_id ||
        activeItem.requester_unit_id === user.unit_id)
  );

  if (!open) return null;

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // HANDLERS
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleApprove = async (proposalId: string) => {
    const target = proposals.find((p) => p.proposal_id === proposalId);
    if (target && target.requester_id === user?.user_id && !canSelfApprove) {
      toast.error('Bạn không thể tự phê duyệt đề xuất của chính mình.', {
        title: 'BỊ CHẶN',
        badge: 'SELF_APPROVE_DENIED',
      });
      return;
    }

    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await documentService.approveProposal(
        proposalId,
        isCommanderRole
          ? 'Chỉ huy cấp Phòng đã phê duyệt & chuẩn hóa'
          : 'Quản trị viên đã phê duyệt & áp dụng'
      );
      toast.success(res.message || 'Đã phê duyệt đề xuất thành công', {
        title: 'PHÊ DUYỆT THÀNH CÔNG',
        badge: 'APPROVED',
      });
      setSelectedProposal(null);
      onRefresh();
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error('Lỗi phê duyệt: ' + (err.message || 'Không thể thực thi'), {
        title: 'THẤT BẠI',
      });
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmAction = async (proposalId: string) => {
    const target = proposals.find((p) => p.proposal_id === proposalId);
    if (target && target.requester_id === user?.user_id && !canSelfApprove) {
      toast.error('Bạn không thể tự xử lý đề xuất của chính mình.', {
        title: 'BỊ CHẶN',
        badge: 'SELF_ACTION_DENIED',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!inputText.trim()) {
      toast.warning(
        actionInputMode === 'reject'
          ? 'Vui lòng nhập lý do từ chối đề xuất'
          : 'Vui lòng nhập nội dung yêu cầu giải trình'
      );
      return;
    }

    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      const noteToSend =
        actionInputMode === 'reject'
          ? inputText.trim()
          : `[YÊU CẦU GIẢI TRÌNH] ${inputText.trim()}`;

      const res = await documentService.rejectProposal(proposalId, noteToSend);
      toast.info(
        actionInputMode === 'reject'
          ? res.message || 'Đã từ chối đề xuất'
          : 'Đã gửi yêu cầu giải trình tới cán bộ',
        {
          title: actionInputMode === 'reject' ? 'ĐÃ TỪ CHỐI' : 'YÊU CẦU GIẢI TRÌNH',
          badge: actionInputMode === 'reject' ? 'REJECTED' : 'EXPLANATION_REQUIRED',
        }
      );
      setActionInputMode('idle');
      setInputText('');
      setSelectedProposal(null);
      onRefresh();
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error('Lỗi: ' + (err.message || 'Không thể thực thi'), {
        title: 'THẤT BẠI',
      });
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // DANH SÁCH DIFF FIELDS ĐỐI CHIẾU
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const isNewUpload = Boolean(
    activeItem?.deleted_reason === 'PENDING_APPROVAL' ||
    activeItem?.is_new_upload ||
    activeItem?.note?.includes('Đăng tải')
  );

  const diffFields = activeItem
    ? [
        {
          label: 'Số hiệu / Ký hiệu văn bản',
          oldValue: isNewUpload ? '(Văn bản mới)' : (activeItem.current_document_code || '—'),
          newValue: activeItem.document_code || activeItem.current_document_code || '—',
          hasChanged: isNewUpload || (
            Boolean(activeItem.document_code) &&
            activeItem.document_code !== activeItem.current_document_code
          ),
          isMono: true,
        },
        {
          label: 'Trích yếu nội dung văn bản',
          oldValue: isNewUpload ? '(Văn bản mới)' : activeItem.current_title,
          newValue: activeItem.title,
          hasChanged: isNewUpload || (activeItem.title.trim() !== activeItem.current_title.trim()),
        },
        {
          label: 'Đơn vị ban hành',
          oldValue: isNewUpload ? '(Chưa có)' : (activeItem.current_unit_name || '—'),
          newValue: activeItem.issuing_unit_name || activeItem.current_unit_name || '—',
          hasChanged: isNewUpload || (
            Boolean(activeItem.issuing_unit_name) &&
            activeItem.issuing_unit_name !== activeItem.current_unit_name
          ),
        },
        {
          label: 'Người ký ban hành',
          oldValue: isNewUpload ? '(Chưa có)' : (activeItem.current_signer || '—'),
          newValue: activeItem.signer || activeItem.current_signer || '—',
          hasChanged: isNewUpload || (
            Boolean(activeItem.signer) && activeItem.signer !== activeItem.current_signer
          ),
        },
        {
          label: 'Cấp độ bảo mật (Độ mật)',
          oldValue: isNewUpload ? '(Chưa có)' : (
            activeItem.current_security_name ||
            `Cấp ${activeItem.current_security_level_id}`
          ),
          newValue:
            activeItem.security_level_name || `Cấp ${activeItem.security_level_id}`,
          hasChanged: isNewUpload || (
            activeItem.security_level_id !== activeItem.current_security_level_id
          ),
        },
        {
          label: 'Ngày ban hành',
          oldValue: isNewUpload ? '(Chưa có)' : (activeItem.current_issued_date
            ? new Date(activeItem.current_issued_date).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')
            : '—'),
          newValue: activeItem.issued_date
            ? new Date(activeItem.issued_date).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')
            : activeItem.current_issued_date
            ? new Date(activeItem.current_issued_date).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')
            : '—',
          hasChanged: isNewUpload || (
            Boolean(activeItem.issued_date) &&
            activeItem.issued_date !== activeItem.current_issued_date
          ),
        },
      ]
    : [];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl overflow-hidden font-sans">
        {/* ========================================================= */}
        {/* HEADER MODAL VỚI BADGE PHÂN CẤP THẨM QUYỀN              */}
        {/* ========================================================= */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0">
              <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                  Đề Xuất Chỉnh Sửa & Chuẩn Hóa Văn Bản
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
                  {proposals.length} chờ duyệt
                </span>

                {/* 🎖️ BADGE PHÂN CẤP THẨM QUYỀN DUYỆT */}
                {isCommanderRole ? (
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Shield className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                    Thẩm quyền duyệt: Chỉ huy cấp Phòng
                  </span>
                ) : isAdminRole ? (
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40 shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Shield className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
                    Thẩm quyền duyệt: Quản trị viên
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                    Chờ Chỉ huy / Admin duyệt
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5 truncate">
                Kiểm duyệt đối chiếu trực quan thông tin do Trợ lý, Văn thư, Cơ yếu đề xuất
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer shrink-0 ml-2"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* ========================================================= */}
        {/* CONTENT BODY                                             */}
        {/* ========================================================= */}
        {proposals.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-16 text-center space-y-3">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-7 h-7" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              Hiện tại không có đề xuất chỉnh sửa nào đang chờ phê duyệt.
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Mọi văn bản đều đã được đồng bộ chuẩn hóa theo phân cấp quản lý.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 divide-y md:divide-y-0 md:divide-x divide-slate-200 dark:divide-slate-800">
            {/* Cột 1: Danh sách đề xuất bên trái */}
            <div className="p-3 overflow-y-auto max-h-[72vh] space-y-2 bg-slate-50/30 dark:bg-slate-950/20">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider px-2 pb-1">
                Danh sách chờ xét duyệt
              </div>
              {proposals.map((item) => {
                const isSelected = activeItem?.proposal_id === item.proposal_id;
                const isOwnProposal = item.requester_id === user?.user_id;
                const itemInternal = Boolean(
                  user?.unit_id &&
                    (item.issuing_unit_id === user.unit_id ||
                      item.document_issuing_unit_id === user.unit_id ||
                      item.requester_unit_id === user.unit_id)
                );

                return (
                  <button
                    key={item.proposal_id}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSelectedProposal(item);
                      setActionInputMode('idle');
                      setInputText('');
                    }}
                    className={`w-full text-left p-3.5 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-emerald-50/90 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-500/50 shadow-sm'
                        : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {item.document_code || item.current_document_code || 'VĂN BẢN'}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                        {new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 line-clamp-2 mt-1">
                      {item.title}
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-2 flex-wrap">
                      <User className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">{item.requester_name}</span>
                      {(item.deleted_reason === 'PENDING_APPROVAL' || item.is_new_upload || item.note?.includes('Đăng tải')) && (
                        <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30 shrink-0">
                          TẢI MỚI
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {isOwnProposal && (
                        <span className="ml-auto text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 shrink-0">
                          CỦA BẠN
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {itemInternal && (
                        <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30 shrink-0">
                          NỘI BỘ
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Cột 2 & 3: Chi tiết đối chiếu dữ liệu chuẩn hóa & Sticky Footer */}
            {activeItem && (
              <div className="md:col-span-2 flex flex-col h-full max-h-[72vh] overflow-hidden bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/20">
                {/* Vùng Cuộn Nội Dung Diff */}
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
                  {/* Card Thông tin người đề xuất */}
                  <div className="p-3.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shadow-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-600 to-teal-800 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-sm border border-white dark:border-slate-800">
                        {getInitials(activeItem.requester_name)}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                            {activeItem.requester_name}
                          </span>
                          {activeItem.requester_rank && (
                            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                              ({activeItem.requester_rank})
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {isInternalUnit && (
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30">
                              Tài liệu nội bộ phòng
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                          Chức vụ: {activeItem.requester_position || 'Cán bộ nghiệp vụ'} • Gửi lúc:{' '}
                          {new Date(activeItem.created_at).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
                      Chờ duyệt
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* GITHUB-STYLE DIFF VIEWER */}
                  <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                        Đối Chiếu Dữ Liệu Chuẩn Hóa
                      </h3>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-[10px]">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 font-semibold">
                          <MinusCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Cũ (bị xóa)
                        </span>
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                          <PlusCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Mới (đề xuất)
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800/80 shadow-xs">
                      {diffFields.map((field, idx) => {
                        if (field.hasChanged) {
                          return (
                            <div
                              key={idx}
                              className="p-3 bg-amber-50/25 dark:bg-amber-950/15 transition-colors"
                            >
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                                  {field.label}
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
                                  CÓ THAY ĐỔI
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                                <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 dark:bg-red-950/30 border border-red-500/20 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 flex items-start gap-1.5">
                                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-red-500 shrink-0 select-none">-</span>
                                  <span className={`line-through break-words ${field.isMono ? 'font-mono' : ''}`}>
                                    {field.oldValue}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 font-semibold flex items-start gap-1.5">
                                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0 select-none">+</span>
                                  <span className={`break-words ${field.isMono ? 'font-mono' : ''}`}>
                                    {field.newValue}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        }
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={idx}
                            className="px-3.5 py-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors"
                          >
                            <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium w-1/3 truncate">
                              {field.label}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold w-1/2 truncate">
                              {field.oldValue}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 italic shrink-0">
                              (Giữ nguyên)
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}

                      {/* File PDF mới thay thế */}
                      {activeItem.new_stored_path && (
                        <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/40 dark:bg-blue-950/20">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              {isNewUpload ? 'Tệp PDF Văn Bản Mới Đăng Tải' : 'Tệp PDF Đính Kèm Thay Thế'}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30">
                              FILE MỚI
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/10 border border-blue-500/20 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200 text-xs font-mono flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-bold text-blue-600">+</span>
                            <span>
                              {activeItem.new_original_name || 'tai_lieu_chuan_hoa.pdf'}
                            </span>
                            {activeItem.new_file_size && (
                              <span className="text-slate-400 font-sans text-[11px] ml-auto">
                                ({Math.round(activeItem.new_file_size / 1024)} KB)
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Lý do đề xuất */}
                  {activeItem.note && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/25 rounded-xl text-xs text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-start gap-2 shadow-xs">
                      <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        <strong className="block text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 mb-0.5 font-bold">
                          Lý do đề xuất:
                        </strong>
                        <p className="italic">"{activeItem.note}"</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Cảnh báo tự duyệt */}
                  {blockSelfApprove && (
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-semibold bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 p-3 rounded-xl border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800">
                      <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <span>
                        Bạn không thể tự phê duyệt hoặc từ chối đề xuất do chính mình tạo ra.
                        Vui lòng chuyển cho Chỉ huy hoặc Quản trị viên khác xử lý.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* ========================================================= */}
                {/* STICKY FOOTER: COMMANDER ACTION HUB                       */}
                {/* ========================================================= */}
                <div className="sticky bottom-0 bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-3.5 shrink-0 z-10">
                  {actionInputMode === 'reject' ? (
                    <div className="space-y-2 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <label className="text-xs font-bold text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-600" />
                          <span>Nhập lý do từ chối đề xuất (Bắt buộc):</span>
                        </label>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setActionInputMode('idle');
                            setInputText('');
                          }}
                          className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-300 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          Quay lại
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      <textarea
                        value={inputText}
                        onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Nêu rõ lý do từ chối để cán bộ chỉnh sửa lại (ví dụ: Số hiệu chưa chính xác, thiếu ngày ban hành...)"
                        rows={2}
                        autoFocus
                        disabled={actionLoading}
                        className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-red-300 dark:border-red-800/60 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500 disabled:opacity-50"
                      />

                      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setActionInputMode('idle');
                            setInputText('');
                          }}
                          disabled={actionLoading}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          Hủy
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleConfirmAction(activeItem.proposal_id)}
                          disabled={actionLoading || !inputText.trim()}
                          className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 transition shadow-xs"
                        >
                          {actionLoading ? (
                            <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                          ) : (
                            <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          )}
                          <span>Xác nhận từ chối</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    /* 2 NÚT HÀNH ĐỘNG DUY NHẤT: TỪ CHỐI & PHÊ DUYỆT */
                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {hasRealPermissionToApprove ? (
                          <span>Chỉ huy / Quản trị viên chịu trách nhiệm phê duyệt.</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="italic">
                            Đề xuất đang ở trạng thái chờ Chỉ huy hoặc Quản trị viên duyệt.
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
                        {hasRealPermissionToApprove && !blockSelfApprove && (
                          <>
                            {/* NÚT 1: TỪ CHỐI (Ghost viền đỏ) */}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setActionInputMode('reject')}
                              disabled={actionLoading}
                              className="px-4 py-2 border border-red-500 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Từ chối</span>
                            </button>

                            {/* NÚT 2: PHÊ DUYỆT & CẬP NHẬT (Solid Xanh Lục Quân Đậm) */}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleApprove(activeItem.proposal_id)}
                              disabled={actionLoading}
                              className="px-5 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-emerald-950/20 transition cursor-pointer active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                              {actionLoading ? (
                                <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                              ) : (
                                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[2.5]" />
                              )}
                              <span>{isNewUpload ? 'Phê duyệt & Tiếp nhận văn bản' : 'Phê duyệt & Cập nhật'}</span>
                            </button>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { FileText, Eye, Download, Lock, Calendar, Building, HardDrive } from 'lucide-react';
import { DocumentItem } from '../../types';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/dateUtils';
import { formatFileSize } from '../../utils/formatFileSize';
import { CompactDownloadButton } from '../common/CompactDownloadButton';

export interface DocumentCardProps {
  document: DocumentItem;
  userClearanceLevel: number;
  onPreview: (doc: DocumentItem) => void;
  onDownload: (doc: DocumentItem, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<(() => void) | void> | (() => void) | void;
  onCancelDownload?: (doc: DocumentItem) => void;
}

export const DocumentCard: React.FC<DocumentCardProps> = ({
  document,
  userClearanceLevel,
  onPreview,
  onDownload,
  onCancelDownload,
}) => {
  const isRestricted = (document.security_level_id || 1) > userClearanceLevel;

  const getLevelBadgeClass = (lv: number) => {
    switch (lv) {
      case 5:
        return 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 border-red-500/30';
      case 4:
        return 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-500/30';
      case 3:
        return 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30';
      case 2:
        return 'bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-500/30';
      default:
        return 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30';
    }
  };

  const docLevel = document.security_level_id || 1;
  // Cấp 1, 2: được tải về nếu clearance >= docLevel. Từ cấp 3 trở đi (Cấp 3, 4, 5): CHỈ ĐƯỢC XEM, KHÔNG ĐƯỢC TẢI VỀ
  const canDownload = docLevel <= 2 && docLevel <= userClearanceLevel;
  const isSecretLevel = docLevel >= 3;

  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#111827] p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-emerald-600/40 dark:hover:border-emerald-500/40 transition-colors duration-150 group">
      <div>
        {/* Top Badges */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2.5">
          <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-amber-800 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-600/25 dark:text-amber-400 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:border-amber-500/25 tracking-wide truncate">
            {document.document_code}
          </span>
          <span
            className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border shrink-0 ${getLevelBadgeClass(
              document.security_level_id || 1
            )}`}
          >
            {document.security_name || document.security_level_name || `Cấp ${document.security_level_id}`}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Title */}
        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white group-hover:text-emerald-700 dark:group-hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors line-clamp-2 mb-2">
          {document.title}
        </h4>

        {/* Summary */}
        {document.summary && (
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 line-clamp-2 mb-3">
            {document.summary}
          </p>
        )}

        {/* Metadata Details */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 pt-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 shrink-0">Thể loại:</span>
            <span
              className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium text-right flex-1 break-normal leading-snug"
              title={document.doc_type_name || document.type_name}
            >
              {document.doc_type_name || document.type_name || '—'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 shrink-0">Đơn vị:</span>
            <span
              className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium text-right flex-1 break-normal leading-snug"
              title={document.unit_name}
            >
              {document.unit_name || '—'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 shrink-0">Ngày BH:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium text-right">
              {formatDate(document.issued_date || document.issue_date)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 shrink-0">Dung lượng:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium text-right">
              {formatFileSize(document.file_size ?? document.file_size_bytes)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Action Footer */}
      <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
        {isRestricted ? (
          <div className="w-full min-h-[40px] py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
            <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Giới hạn quyền truy cập</span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                try {
                  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && !window.document.fullscreenElement) {
                    window.document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {});
                  }
                } catch (_) {}
                onPreview(document);
              }}
              className="flex-1 min-h-[40px] py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Xem văn bản PDF</span>
            </button>
            <CompactDownloadButton
              onDownload={(signal) => onDownload(document, signal)}
              onCancel={() => onCancelDownload?.(document)}
              disabled={!canDownload}
              disabledTitle={
                isSecretLevel
                  ? 'Tài liệu từ Cấp 3 trở lên chỉ duy nhất cho phép xem trực tiếp, không được phép tải về máy'
                  : `Cấp độ bảo mật (Cấp ${userClearanceLevel}) không đủ để tải văn bản Cấp ${docLevel}`
              }
              fileSize={formatFileSize(document.file_size ?? document.file_size_bytes)}
              size="normal"
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Skeleton } from 'antd';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { DocumentItem } from '../../types';
import { DocumentCard } from './DocumentCard';
import { TacticalEmptyState } from '../common/TacticalEmptyState';

export interface PortalDocumentListProps {
  documents: DocumentItem[];
  userClearanceLevel: number;
  loading?: boolean;
  currentPage: number;
  totalPages: number;
  totalItems: number;
  searchQuery?: string;
  onClearFilters?: () => void;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  onPreview: (doc: DocumentItem) => void;
  onDownload: (doc: DocumentItem, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<(() => void) | void> | (() => void) | void;
  onCancelDownload?: (doc: DocumentItem) => void;
}

export const PortalDocumentList: React.FC<PortalDocumentListProps> = ({
  documents,
  userClearanceLevel,
  loading = false,
  currentPage,
  totalPages,
  totalItems,
  searchQuery,
  onClearFilters,
  onPageChange,
  onPreview,
  onDownload,
  onCancelDownload,
}) => {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, idx) => (
          <div
            key={`portal-doc-skeleton-${idx}`}
            className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#111827] rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4"
          >
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center gap-2">
                <Skeleton.Button active size="small" style={{ width: 85, height: 22, borderRadius: 6 }} />
                <Skeleton.Button active size="small" style={{ width: 70, height: 22, borderRadius: 6 }} />
              </div>
              <Skeleton active paragraph={{ rows: 2, width: ['100%', '75%'] }} title={{ width: '85%' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-between">
              <Skeleton.Input active size="small" style={{ width: 110, height: 18, borderRadius: 4 }} />
              <Skeleton.Button active size="small" style={{ width: 75, height: 28, borderRadius: 8 }} />
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (documents.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm backdrop-blur-md overflow-hidden">
        <TacticalEmptyState
          title="Không tìm thấy văn bản phù hợp"
          description="Không có tài liệu nào khớp với từ khóa tìm kiếm hoặc bộ lọc hiện tại. Đồng chí vui lòng kiểm tra lại từ khóa hoặc xóa bộ lọc."
          searchQuery={searchQuery}
          onClearFilters={onClearFilters}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {documents.map((doc, idx) => (
          <div
            key={doc.file_id}
            id={idx === 0 ? 'tour-document-card' : undefined}
            data-tour={idx === 0 ? 'document-card' : undefined}
            className="h-full"
          >
            <DocumentCard
              document={doc}
              userClearanceLevel={userClearanceLevel}
              onPreview={onPreview}
              onDownload={onDownload}
              onCancelDownload={onCancelDownload}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 shadow-sm">
          <div>
            Hiển thị trang{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{currentPage}</span> /{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{totalPages}</span> (Tổng{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{totalItems}</span> tài liệu)
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
            <button
              onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(1, currentPage - 1))}
              disabled={currentPage <= 1}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
            {Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1)
              .filter((p) => p === 1 || p === totalPages || Math.abs(p - currentPage) <= 1)
              .map((p, idx, arr) => {
                const prev = arr[idx - 1];
                const showEllipsis = prev && p - prev > 1;
                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={p}>
                    {showEllipsis && <span className="px-1 text-slate-400">...</span>}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onPageChange(p)}
                      className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded transition text-xs ${
                        currentPage === p
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {p}
                    </button>
                  </React.Fragment>
                );
              })}
            <button
              onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1))}
              disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  FolderKanban,
  Building2,
  ShieldCheck,
  Activity,
  BarChart3,
  PieChart,
  Shield,
  FileText,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Lock,
  KeyRound,
  Layers,
  ChevronRight,
  Filter,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { DocumentItem, MetaData, Unit, User } from '../../types';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/dateUtils';
import { formatFileSize } from '../../utils/formatFileSize';
import { RollingNumber } from '../common/RollingNumber';

export interface SchoolOverviewSectionProps {
  documents: DocumentItem[];
  meta: MetaData;
  tqsDepartments: Unit[];
  mainUnits: Unit[];
  selectedUnit: string;
  selectedDepartment: string;
  selectedType: string;
  selectedLevel: number | '';
  onSelectDepartment: (unitId: string, isDeptOfTqs: boolean) => void;
  onSelectType: (typeId: string) => void;
  onSelectLevel: (levelId: number | '') => void;
  onResetFilters: () => void;
  userClearanceLevel?: number;
  user?: User | null;
}

export const SchoolOverviewSection: React.FC<SchoolOverviewSectionProps> = ({
  documents,
  meta,
  tqsDepartments,
  mainUnits,
  selectedUnit,
  selectedDepartment,
  selectedType,
  selectedLevel,
  onSelectDepartment,
  onSelectType,
  onSelectLevel,
  onResetFilters,
  userClearanceLevel = 5,
  user = null,
}) => {
  // Tab góc nhìn cho Bảng Phải: 'type' (Theo Thể Loại) hoặc 'level' (Theo Cấp Độ Mật)
  const [rightPanelTab, setRightPanelTab] = useState<'type' | 'level'>('type');

  const totalCount = documents.length;

  // 1. Thẻ 1: Tổng dung lượng kho & số văn bản mới trong 30 ngày qua
  const totalBytes = useMemo(() => {
    return documents.reduce(
      (sum, d) => sum + (Number(d.file_size_bytes ?? d.file_size) || 0),
      0
    );
  }, [documents]);

  const new30DaysDocs = useMemo(() => {
    const now = new Date();
    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    return documents.filter((d) => {
      const dateVal = d.issued_date || d.issue_date || d.created_at;
      if (!dateVal) return false;
      const dt = new Date(dateVal);
      return !isNaN(dt.getTime()) && dt >= thirtyDaysAgo;
    });
  }, [documents]);

  // 2. Thống kê tiến độ các phòng ban trực thuộc Trường Quân sự Quân khu 7
  const schoolUnitsList = useMemo(() => {
    // Chỉ lấy duy nhất các phòng ban con của Trường Quân sự Quân khu 7 (loại bỏ hoàn toàn cơ quan bên ngoài/cấp trên)
    return tqsDepartments.map((d) => ({
      unit_id: d.unit_id,
      name: d.unit_id === 'U-BGH' ? 'Ban Giám hiệu' : d.name,
      isDeptOfTqs: true,
    }));
  }, [tqsDepartments]);

  const unitStats = useMemo(() => {
    // Tổng số văn bản thuộc phạm vi Trường Quân sự Quân khu 7 (bao gồm văn bản cấp trường TQS và các phòng ban con)
    const tqsDocs = documents.filter((d) => {
      const uId = d.issuing_unit_id;
      return (
        uId === 'TQS' ||
        uId === 'U-TQS' ||
        tqsDepartments.some((dept) => dept.unit_id === uId) ||
        (d.unit_name &&
          (d.unit_name.toLowerCase().includes('ban giám hiệu') ||
            d.unit_name.toLowerCase().includes('trường quân sự')))
      );
    });
    const totalSchoolDocs = tqsDocs.length > 0 ? tqsDocs.length : 1;

    return schoolUnitsList
      .map((unit) => {
        const subUnitIds = meta.units.filter((u) => u.parent_id === unit.unit_id).map((u) => u.unit_id);

        const unitDocs = documents.filter((d) => {
          if (unit.unit_id === 'U-BGH') {
            // Ban Giám hiệu phụ trách các văn bản do Nhà trường / Ban Giám hiệu ký (TQS, U-TQS, U-BGH)
            return (
              d.issuing_unit_id === 'U-BGH' ||
              d.issuing_unit_id === 'TQS' ||
              d.issuing_unit_id === 'U-TQS' ||
              (d.unit_name &&
                (d.unit_name.toLowerCase().includes('ban giám hiệu') ||
                  d.unit_name.toLowerCase().includes('trường quân sự')))
            );
          }
          if (d.issuing_unit_id === unit.unit_id) return true;
          if (d.unit_name && d.unit_name.toLowerCase() === unit.name.toLowerCase()) return true;
          // Bao gồm cả tài liệu của các đơn vị con trực thuộc (ví dụ Bếp cơ quan con của Phòng Hậu cần - Kỹ thuật)
          if (subUnitIds.includes(d.issuing_unit_id)) return true;
          return false;
        });

        const count = unitDocs.length;
        const secretCount = unitDocs.filter(
          (d) => (d.security_level_id || 1) >= 3
        ).length;
        const normalCount = count - secretCount;
        const pctOfTotal = (count / totalSchoolDocs) * 100;

        // SLA Traffic-Light status:
        // count >= 3: Đạt chuẩn / Đúng tiến độ (Green)
        // 1 <= count <= 2: Cần bổ sung (Yellow)
        // count === 0: Chậm tiến độ (Red)
        let slaStatus: 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';
        let slaLabel: string;
        if (count >= 3) {
          slaStatus = 'success';
          slaLabel = 'Đúng tiến độ';
        } else if (count >= 1) {
          slaStatus = 'warning';
          slaLabel = 'Cần bổ sung';
        } else {
          slaStatus = 'danger';
          slaLabel = 'Chậm tiến độ • Chưa nộp';
        }

        return {
          ...unit,
          count,
          normalCount,
          secretCount,
          pctOfTotal,
          slaStatus,
          slaLabel,
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        // Đơn vị nhiều tài liệu lên trước, các đơn vị 0 tài liệu xếp sau
        if (b.count !== a.count) return b.count - a.count;
        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'vi');
      });
  }, [schoolUnitsList, documents, tqsDepartments]);

  const totalUnitsCount = unitStats.length;
  const unitsWithDocsCount = unitStats.filter((u) => u.count > 0).length;
  const zeroDocUnitsCount = unitStats.filter((u) => u.count === 0).length;
  const unitProgressPct =
    totalUnitsCount > 0 ? Math.round((unitsWithDocsCount / totalUnitsCount) * 100) : 100;
  const leadingUnit = unitStats[0]?.count > 0 ? unitStats[0] : null;

  // 3. Thẻ 3: Cơ cấu bảo mật toàn trường
  const publicInternalCount = useMemo(
    () => documents.filter((d) => (d.security_level_id || 1) <= 2).length,
    [documents]
  );
  const secretCount = useMemo(
    () => documents.filter((d) => (d.security_level_id || 1) === 3).length,
    [documents]
  );
  const topSecretCount = useMemo(
    () => documents.filter((d) => (d.security_level_id || 1) >= 4).length,
    [documents]
  );
  const secretPlusCount = secretCount + topSecretCount;

  // 3. Thẻ 3: Quyền Khai Thác Của Bạn (Clearance Access KPI toàn trường)
  const accessibleDocsCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      documents.filter((d) => (d.security_level_id || 1) <= userClearanceLevel).length,
    [documents, userClearanceLevel]
  );
  const accessiblePct =
    totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((accessibleDocsCount / totalCount) * 100) : 100;

  const clearanceName = useMemo(() => {
    switch (userClearanceLevel) {
      case 5:
        return 'Tuyệt mật (Cấp 5)';
      case 4:
        return 'Tối mật (Cấp 4)';
      case 3:
        return 'Mật (Cấp 3)';
      case 2:
        return 'Nội bộ (Cấp 2)';
      default:
        return 'Công khai (Cấp 1)';
    }
  }, [userClearanceLevel]);

  const publicPct = totalCount > 0 ? (publicInternalCount / totalCount) * 100 : 0;
  const secretPct = totalCount > 0 ? (secretCount / totalCount) * 100 : 0;
  const topSecretPct = totalCount > 0 ? (topSecretCount / totalCount) * 100 : 0;

  // 4. Thẻ 4: Tình trạng chuẩn hóa phân bổ
  const standardizedCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      documents.filter(
        (d) =>
          Boolean(d.issuing_unit_id) &&
          Boolean(d.doc_type_id || d.type_id || d.doc_type_name)
      ).length,
    [documents]
  );
  const standardizedPct =
    totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((standardizedCount / totalCount) * 100) : 100;

  const latestDateStr = useMemo(() => {
    const sorted = [...documents]
      .filter((d) => d.issued_date || d.issue_date || d.created_at)
      .sort(
        (a, b) =>
          new Date(b.issued_date || b.issue_date || b.created_at || 0).getTime() -
          new Date(a.issued_date || a.issue_date || a.created_at || 0).getTime()
      );
    return sorted[0]
      ? formatDate(sorted[0].issued_date || sorted[0].issue_date || sorted[0].created_at)
      : 'Chưa có văn bản';
  }, [documents]);

  // Dữ liệu cho Bảng Phải: Thể loại văn bản
  const typeDistribution = useMemo(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    documents.forEach((d) => {
      const typeId = d.doc_type_id || d.type_id || '';
      const typeName = d.doc_type_name || d.type_name || 'Văn bản khác';
      const key = typeId || typeName;
      counts[key] = (counts[key] || 0) + 1;
    });

    // Merge với meta.types để hiển thị đầy đủ
    const list = meta.types.map((t) => ({
      id: t.type_id,
      label: t.name,
      count: counts[t.type_id] || counts[t.name] || 0,
      pct: totalCount > 0 ? ((counts[t.type_id] || counts[t.name] || 0) / totalCount) * 100 : 0,
    }));

    return list.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
  }, [documents, meta.types, totalCount]);

  // Dữ liệu cho Bảng Phải: Cấp độ bảo mật
  const securityLevelDistribution = useMemo(() => {
    const levelConfigs = [

      return {

            </span>

              const maxUnitDocs = Math.max(...unitStats.map((u) => u.count), 1);

                  const isSelected = selectedType === item.id;
                  const maxTypeCount = Math.max(...typeDistribution.map((t) => t.count), 1);
                  const barWidth = item.count > 0 ? Math.max(6, (item.count / maxTypeCount) * 100) : 0;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      onClick={() => onSelectType(item.id)}
                      className={`p-2 rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer select-none ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 ring-1 ring-emerald-500/50'
                          : 'border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.04] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-white/[0.02]'
                      }`}
                      title={`Nhấn để lọc thể loại: ${item.label}`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs mb-1">
                        <span
                          className={`truncate font-medium ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold'
                              : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {item.label}
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 font-mono tabular-nums">
                          <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                            {item.count}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            ({Math.round(item.pct)}%)
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                        {item.count > 0 && (
                          <div
                            style={{ width: `${barWidth}%` }}
                            className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-500 h-full transition-all duration-300"
                          />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Nội dung Tab 2: Phân bố theo Mức độ bảo mật */}
            {rightPanelTab === 'level' && (
              <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-2 max-h-[340px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {securityLevelDistribution.map((item) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedLevel === item.id;
                  const maxLevelCount = Math.max(...securityLevelDistribution.map((l) => l.count), 1);
                  const barWidth = item.count > 0 ? Math.max(6, (item.count / maxLevelCount) * 100) : 0;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      onClick={() => onSelectLevel(item.id)}
                      className={`p-2 rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer select-none ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 ring-1 ring-emerald-500/50'
                          : 'border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.04] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-white/[0.02]'
                      }`}
                      title={`Nhấn để lọc văn bản ${item.label}`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs mb-1">
                        <span className={`truncate font-semibold ${item.text}`}>
                          {item.label}
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 font-mono tabular-nums">
                          <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                            {item.count} Văn bản
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            ({Math.round(item.pct)}%)
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                        {item.count > 0 && (
                          <div
                            style={{ width: `${barWidth}%` }}
                            className={`${item.color} h-full transition-all duration-300`}
                          />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            <span>
              {rightPanelTab === 'type' ? 'Đang xem theo Thể loại' : 'Đang xem theo Mức độ mật'}
            </span>
            {(selectedType || selectedLevel !== '') && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  onSelectType('');
                  onSelectLevel('');
                }}
                className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                Xóa lọc cơ cấu
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
