import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  X,
  RefreshCw,
  Cable,
  Fingerprint,
  KeyRound,           // ← gộp vào đây
} from 'lucide-react';
import { fingerprintService } from '../../services/fingerprintService';
import { http } from '../../services/http';
import { userService } from '../../services/userService';   // ✅ FIX #1: import
import { TouchIDFingerprint } from '../common/TouchIDFingerprint';
import { CircularSpinner } from './FingerprintEnrollModal';
import { PinVerifyModal } from './PinVerifyModal';

export interface FingerprintScanModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  fileId?: string;
  purpose?: 'file_access' | 'admin_login';
  tempTicket?: string;
  onSuccess: (fingerprintToken: string) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  // ✅ FIX #2: thêm onToast vào interface
  onToast?: (message: string, type: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning') => void;
}

type Phase = 'scanning' | 'success' | 'error';

const MAX_AUTO_RETRY = 2;

export const FingerprintScanModal: React.FC<FingerprintScanModalProps> = ({
  open,
  fileId = '',
  purpose = 'file_access',
  tempTicket,
  onSuccess,
  onCancel,
  onToast = () => {},        // ✅ FIX #2: default no-op
}) => {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('scanning');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');
  const [score, setScore] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [needsEnroll, setNeedsEnroll] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const [retryExhausted, setRetryExhausted] = useState(false);
  const [pinChallenge, setPinChallenge] = useState<{ token: string; level: number } | null>(null);
  const [pinNotSet, setPinNotSet] = useState(false);
  // ✅ state mới cho nút gửi yêu cầu cấp PIN (loading + message inline dưới nút)
  const [pinReqLoading, setPinReqLoading] = useState(false);
  const [pinReqMessage, setPinReqMessage] = useState('');

  const inFlightRef = useRef(false);
  const autoRetryTimerRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const retryCountRef = useRef(0);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    setProgress(phase === 'success' ? 100 : 0);
  }, [phase]);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      abortRef.current = null;
      if (autoRetryTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoRetryTimerRef.current);
        autoRetryTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      inFlightRef.current = false;
      retryCountRef.current = 0;
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      abortRef.current = null;
      if (autoRetryTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoRetryTimerRef.current);
        autoRetryTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      // ✅ FIX #5: reset state khi đóng modal để lần mở sau không dính lỗi cũ
      setPinChallenge(null);
      setPinNotSet(false);
      setRetryExhausted(false);
      setNeedsEnroll(false);
      setError('');
      setScore(null);
      setPhase('scanning');
      // ✅ reset state gửi PIN
      setPinReqLoading(false);
      setPinReqMessage('');
      return;
    }
    if (inFlightRef.current) return;

    inFlightRef.current = true;
    setPhase('scanning');
    setError('');
    setScore(null);
    setNeedsEnroll(false);
    setRetryExhausted(false);
    setPinNotSet(false);
    setPinReqMessage('');
    triggerScan();
    // eslint-disable-next-line
  }, [open, fileId, attempt]);

  const triggerScan = async () => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;
    const signal = controller.signal;

    try {
      let deviceId: string;
      try {
        deviceId = await fingerprintService.getLocalDeviceId(2000);
      } catch {
        if (signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
        setError('Chưa kết nối máy quét vân tay. Vui lòng bật Fingerprint Agent trên máy này.');
        setPhase('error');
        return;
      }

      if (signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;

      // ── Nhánh 1: 2FA admin login ──
      if (purpose === 'admin_login') {
        if (!tempTicket) {
          setError('Thiếu vé xác thực tạm thời. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.');
          setPhase('error');
          return;
        }
        const res: any = await http('/api/auth/login/admin-fp-verify', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ temp_ticket: tempTicket, device_id: deviceId }),
          signal,
        });
        if (signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
        setScore(res.score || 100);
        setProgress(100);
        setPhase('success');
        retryCountRef.current = 0;
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (mountedRef.current && !signal.aborted) onSuccess(res.token);
        }, 900);
        return;
      }

      // ── Nhánh 2: xác thực xem file ──
      const res = await fingerprintService.verify(fileId, deviceId, signal);
      if (signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;

      if (!res.required) { setPhase('success'); onSuccess(''); return; }

      // Cấp 4-5 đã có PIN → mở modal nhập PIN
      if (res.require_pin && res.pin_challenge_token) {
        setScore(res.score ?? null);
        setProgress(100);
        setPhase('success');
        retryCountRef.current = 0;
        setPinChallenge({
          token: res.pin_challenge_token,
          level: res.security_level_id ?? 4,
        });
        return;
      }

      // Cấp 3: token có sẵn
      if (!res.fingerprint_token) throw new Error('Không nhận được token');
      setScore(res.score ?? null);
      setProgress(100);
      setPhase('success');
      retryCountRef.current = 0;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (mountedRef.current && !signal.aborted) onSuccess(res.fingerprint_token!);
      }, 900);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.name === 'AbortError' || signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;

      const msg = err.message || 'Xác thực thất bại';
      const isAgentOffline = Boolean(
        err.data?.agent_offline ||
        err.data?.device_offline ||
        /DEVICE_OFFLINE/i.test(msg) ||
        /Không tìm thấy.+đầu đọc/i.test(msg) ||
        /Chưa kết nối máy quét/i.test(msg)
      );
      const isNeedsEnroll = Boolean(err.data?.needs_enroll);
      const isPinNotSet = Boolean(err.data?.needs_admin_pin) || err.data?.code === 'PIN_NOT_SET';
      const isTemplateCorrupted =
        err.data?.code === 'TEMPLATE_DECRYPT_FAILED' || /Template vân tay bị hỏng/i.test(msg);
      const isCancelled = Boolean(err.data?.cancelled) || err.message === 'CANCELLED';
      const isTimeout =
        Boolean(err.data?.timeout) || err.status === 408 || /Hết thời gian/i.test(msg);
      const isDeviceError = Boolean(err.data?.device_error) || /Lỗi máy quét/i.test(msg);

      console.error('[FingerprintScanModal] ❌ Lỗi xác thực vân tay:', {
        message: err.message,
        code: err.data?.code,
        details: err.data?.details,
        purpose,
        fileId,
      });

      if (isCancelled) {
        if (retryCountRef.current < 1) {
          retryCountRef.current += 1;
          if (autoRetryTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(autoRetryTimerRef.current);
          autoRetryTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
            if (mountedRef.current && !signal.aborted) handleRetryInternal();
          }, 800);
          return;
        }
        setError('Quá trình quét bị gián đoạn. Vui lòng bấm Quét ngay.');
        setPhase('error');
        setRetryExhausted(true);
        return;
      }

      if (isAgentOffline) {
        setError(
          err.data?.error ||
          'Chưa kết nối hoặc chưa mở được đầu đọc vân tay ZK9500. Vui lòng kiểm tra cáp USB và Agent.'
        );
        setPhase('error');
        setRetryExhausted(true);
      } else if (isTimeout) {
        setError('Hết thời gian chờ đặt ngón tay lên máy quét (quá 30 giây). Vui lòng bấm "Quét ngay" để thử lại.');
        setPhase('error');
        setRetryExhausted(true);
      } else if (isDeviceError) {
        setError(err.data?.error || 'Lỗi thiết bị máy quét vân tay ZK9500.');
        setPhase('error');
        setRetryExhausted(true);
      } else if (isPinNotSet) {
        setError(
          'Tài khoản chưa được cấp mã PIN. Vui lòng gửi yêu cầu đến Quản trị viên (USR-001) để được cấp PIN trước khi mở tài liệu Cấp 4-5.'
        );
        setPhase('error');
        setPinNotSet(true);
        setRetryExhausted(true);
      } else if (isNeedsEnroll) {
        setError('Bạn chưa đăng ký vân tay. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên để đăng ký.');
        setNeedsEnroll(true);
        setPhase('error');
        setRetryExhausted(true);
      } else if (isTemplateCorrupted) {
        setError(
          err.data?.details ||
          'Template vân tay bị hỏng hoặc sai khóa mã hóa hệ thống. Cần đăng ký lại (re-enroll).'
        );
        setPhase('error');
        setRetryExhausted(true);
      } else {
        const cleanMsg = msg.replace(/\s*\(score=\d+\)/gi, '');
        setError(cleanMsg || 'Vân tay không khớp. Vui lòng thử lại.');
        setPhase('error');

        if (retryCountRef.current < MAX_AUTO_RETRY) {
          retryCountRef.current += 1;
          if (autoRetryTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(autoRetryTimerRef.current);
          const delay = 1200 * retryCountRef.current;
          autoRetryTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
            if (mountedRef.current) handleRetryInternal();
          }, delay);
        } else {
          setRetryExhausted(true);
        }
      }
    } finally {
      inFlightRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  const handleRetryInternal = () => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    abortRef.current = null;
    if (autoRetryTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoRetryTimerRef.current);
      autoRetryTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    inFlightRef.current = false;
    setProgress(0);
    setAttempt((n) => n + 1);
  };

  const handleRetry = () => {
    retryCountRef.current = 0;
    setRetryExhausted(false);
    setPinNotSet(false);
    setPinReqMessage('');
    handleRetryInternal();
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    abortRef.current = null;
    if (autoRetryTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoRetryTimerRef.current);
      autoRetryTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    inFlightRef.current = false;
    retryCountRef.current = 0;
    setPinChallenge(null);
    onCancel();
  };

  if (!open) return null;

  const modalNode = (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 bg-slate-900/30 dark:bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-300"
        onClick={handleCancel}
      >
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 10 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 10 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 350 }}
          className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800/90 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md mx-auto overflow-hidden shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl"
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                <Fingerprint className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {purpose === 'admin_login' ? 'Xác Thực Quản Trị Viên' : 'Xác Thực Vân Tay'}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {purpose === 'admin_login'
                    ? 'Yêu cầu xác thực 2 lớp (2FA) cho Admin'
                    : 'Tài liệu Mật / Tối mật / Tuyệt mật'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleCancel}
              className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="p-6 flex flex-col items-center text-center min-h-[310px] justify-center">
            <TouchIDFingerprint
              phase={phase}
              progress={progress}
              size="md"
              className="mb-4"
            />

            {phase === 'scanning' && (
              <>
                <h4 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-1">
                  Đặt ngón tay lên máy quét
                </h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-3 max-w-xs">
                  {purpose === 'admin_login'
                    ? 'Vui lòng đặt ngón tay của Quản trị viên tối cao lên đầu đọc ZK9500'
                    : 'Vui lòng đặt ngón tay đã đăng ký lên đầu đọc ZK9500'}
                </p>
                <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-medium">
                  <CircularSpinner size={12} className="text-red-500 shrink-0" strokeWidth={2.8} />
                  <span>Đang nhận diện vân tay...</span>
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {phase === 'success' && (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mb-1 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold text-base">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5" />
                  <span>Xác thực thành công</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                  {purpose === 'admin_login' ? 'Đang vào hệ thống...' : 'Đang mở tài liệu...'}
                </p>
              </>
            )}

            {phase === 'error' && (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mb-1 text-rose-500 font-bold text-base">
                  {needsEnroll ? <Cable className="w-5 h-5" /> : <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5" />}
                  <span>{needsEnroll ? 'Chưa đăng ký vân tay' : 'Xác thực thất bại'}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 max-w-xs">{error}</p>

                {!needsEnroll && !error.includes('Chưa kết nối') && (
                  retryExhausted ? (
                    <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-medium">
                      <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Đã hết lượt tự động. Vui lòng bấm "Quét ngay" để thử lại.</span>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                      <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      <span>Đang tự động quét lại... Đặt ngón tay lên cảm biến</span>
                    </div>
                  )
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="px-5 py-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
            <button
              onClick={handleCancel}
              className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              {pinNotSet ? 'Đóng' : 'Hủy'}
            </button>

            {pinNotSet ? (
              // ✅ Nút gửi yêu cầu cấp PIN: chống double-click + loading + thông báo inline dưới nút
              <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={async () => {
                    if (pinReqLoading) return;
                    setPinReqLoading(true);
                    setPinReqMessage('');
                    try {
                      await userService.requestPin(fileId);
                      setPinReqMessage('✅ Đã gửi yêu cầu thành công! Vui lòng liên hệ Admin.');
                      // Đợi 2 giây để người dùng đọc thông báo rồi đóng modal
                      setTimeout(() => {
                        // Chỉ đóng nếu modal chưa bị đóng thủ công & component còn mount
                        if (mountedRef.current && abortRef.current !== null) {
                          handleCancel();
                        }
                      }, 2000);
                    } catch (e: any) {
                      setPinReqMessage(`❌ ${e?.message || 'Lỗi gửi yêu cầu'}`);
                    } finally {
                      if (mountedRef.current) setPinReqLoading(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={pinReqLoading || pinReqMessage.includes('✅')}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#166534] to-[#15803d] hover:from-[#14532d] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition shadow-md cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {pinReqLoading ? (
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                  {pinReqLoading ? 'Đang gửi...' : 'Gửi yêu cầu cấp PIN'}
                </button>

                {/* Hiển thị thông báo ngay dưới nút */}
                {pinReqMessage && (
                  <span
                    className={`text-[11px] font-semibold text-right max-w-[250px] ${
                      pinReqMessage.includes('✅') ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {pinReqMessage}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : phase === 'error' && !needsEnroll && (
              // ✅ FIX #4: bỏ điều kiện !retryExhausted → luôn cho phép bấm "Quét ngay"
              <button
                onClick={handleRetry}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#14532d] via-[#166534] to-[#15803d] hover:from-[#166534] hover:to-[#15803d] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition shadow-md shadow-emerald-950/20 border border-amber-500/25 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Quét ngay
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );

  const rendered = (
    <>
      {modalNode}
      <PinVerifyModal
        open={Boolean(pinChallenge)}
        pinChallengeToken={pinChallenge?.token || ''}
        securityLevelId={pinChallenge?.level || 4}
        documentLabel={fileId}
        onSuccess={(finalToken) => {
          setPinChallenge(null);
          onSuccess(finalToken);
        }}
        onCancel={() => {
          setPinChallenge(null);
          handleCancel();
        }}
      />
    </>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined'
    ? createPortal(rendered, document.body)
    : rendered;
};

export default FingerprintScanModal;

import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';

const DANGEROUS_CODES = new Set(['DOC_PURGE', 'PERMISSION_DELETE', 'ROLE_DELETE', 'USER_DELETE']);

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PROPS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export interface GrantPermissionModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  user: User | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
  onToast: (msg: string, type?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info') => void;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MAIN
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export const GrantPermissionModal: React.FC<GrantPermissionModalProps> = ({
  open, user, onClose, onSaved, onToast,
}) => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<PermissionRow[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'all' | 'role' | 'direct' | 'available'>('all');
  const [expandedGroups, setExpandedGroups] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [showGrantDialog, setShowGrantDialog] = useState<PermissionRow | null>(null);
  const [grantExpiresAt, setGrantExpiresAt] = useState('');
  const [grantNote, setGrantNote] = useState('');

  const groupRefs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLDivElement | null>>({});

  // ─── Load & merge ───
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !user) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setSearch('');
    setTab('all');

    Promise.all([
      permissionService.getPermissions(),
      permissionService.getUserPermissions(user.user_id),
    ])
      .then(([catalog, userPerms]) => {
        const allPerms = (catalog.items || []) as Permission[];
        const response = userPerms as UserPermissionResponse;

        const roleMap = new Map<
          string,
          Array<{ role_id: string; role_name: string; expires_at?: string | null }>
        >();
        for (const rp of response.from_roles || []) {
          if (!roleMap.has(rp.permission_id)) roleMap.set(rp.permission_id, []);
          roleMap.get(rp.permission_id)!.push({
            role_id: rp.role_id,
            role_name: rp.role_name,
            expires_at: rp.expires_at ?? null,
          });
        }

        const directMap = new Map<string, UserPermissionResponse['direct_grants'][number]>();
        for (const dg of response.direct_grants || []) directMap.set(dg.permission_id, dg);

        const merged: PermissionRow[] = allPerms
          .map((p): PermissionRow => {
            const roleSources = roleMap.get(p.permission_id) || [];
            const directGrant = directMap.get(p.permission_id);
            const hasRole = roleSources.length > 0;
            const hasDirect = Boolean(directGrant);

            const source: PermissionSource =
              hasRole && hasDirect ? 'both'
              : hasRole ? 'role'
              : hasDirect ? 'direct'
              : 'none';

            const ui_state: PermissionUIState =
              hasRole && hasDirect ? 'direct_active'
              : hasRole ? 'inherited'
              : hasDirect ? 'direct_active'
              : 'available';

            return {
              ...p,
              source,
              role_sources: roleSources,
              direct_grant: directGrant,
              ui_state,
              subgroup: getSubGroupFromPermission(p),
            };
          })
          .sort((a, b) => (a.sort_order ?? 0) - (b.sort_order ?? 0));

        setRows(merged);
        setExpandedGroups(new Set(merged.map((r) => r.group_code || 'SYSTEM')));
      })
      .catch((err) => onToast('Lỗi tải quyền: ' + err.message, 'error'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [open, user, onToast]);

  // ─── Stats ───
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    let fromRole = 0, direct = 0, effective = 0, available = 0, pendingGrants = 0, pendingRevokes = 0;
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (r.source === 'role' || r.source === 'both') fromRole++;
      if (r.source === 'direct' || r.source === 'both') direct++;
      if (r.ui_state !== 'available' && r.ui_state !== 'pending_revoke') effective++;
      if (r.ui_state === 'available') available++;
      if (r.ui_state === 'pending_grant') pendingGrants++;
      if (r.ui_state === 'pending_revoke') pendingRevokes++;
    }
    return { fromRole, direct, effective, available, pendingGrants, pendingRevokes };
  }, [rows]);

  // ─── Filter ───
  const filteredRows = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return rows.filter((r) => {
      if (tab === 'role' && r.source !== 'role' && r.source !== 'both') return false;
      if (tab === 'direct' && r.source !== 'direct' && r.source !== 'both' && r.ui_state !== 'pending_grant') return false;
      if (tab === 'available' && r.source !== 'none' && r.ui_state !== 'pending_grant') return false;
      if (q) {
        const hay = `${r.code || ''} ${r.description || ''} ${r.permission_id}`.toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [rows, tab, search]);

  // ─── Group 2 tầng: group_code → subgroup_key → rows ───
  const groupedData = useMemo(() => {
    const byGroup = new Map<string, PermissionRow[]>();
    for (const r of filteredRows) {
      const g = r.group_code || 'SYSTEM';
      if (!byGroup.has(g)) byGroup.set(g, []);
      byGroup.get(g)!.push(r);
    }

    return Object.keys(GROUP_CONFIG)
      .filter((g) => byGroup.has(g))
      .map((group_code) => {
        const rowsInGroup = byGroup.get(group_code)!;

        const bySub = new Map<string, PermissionRow[]>();
        for (const r of rowsInGroup) {
          if (!bySub.has(r.subgroup.key)) bySub.set(r.subgroup.key, []);
          bySub.get(r.subgroup.key)!.push(r);
        }

        const subgroups = Array.from(bySub.entries())
          .map(([key, subRows]) => {
            const tones = new Set<SubGroupTone>(subRows.map((r) => r.subgroup.tone));
            const tonesArr = Array.from(tones);
            const maxTone = tonesArr.reduce<SubGroupTone>(
              (acc, t) => (TONE_PRIORITY[t] > TONE_PRIORITY[acc] ? t : acc),
              'read'
            );
            return {
              key,
              info: {
                ...subRows[0].subgroup,
                tone: maxTone,
                mixedTone: tones.size > 1,
              } as SubGroupInfo,
              rows: subRows.sort((a, b) =>
                (a.code || '').localeCompare(b.code || '')
              ),
            };
          })
          .sort((a, b) => a.info.order - b.info.order);

        return { group_code, subgroups, total: rowsInGroup.length };
      });
  }, [filteredRows]);

  // ─── Handlers ───
  const toggleExpand = (groupCode: string) => {
    setExpandedGroups((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(groupCode)) next.delete(groupCode);
      else next.add(groupCode);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleTogglePermission = (row: PermissionRow) => {
    if (row.ui_state === 'inherited') {
      onToast('Quyền này kế thừa từ vai trò. Muốn gỡ phải chỉnh vai trò.', 'info');
      return;
    }
    if (row.ui_state === 'direct_active') {
      setRows((prev) =>
        prev.map((r) =>
          r.permission_id === row.permission_id ? { ...r, ui_state: 'pending_revoke' } : r
        )
      );
      return;
    }
    if (row.ui_state === 'pending_revoke') {
      setRows((prev) =>
        prev.map((r) =>
          r.permission_id === row.permission_id ? { ...r, ui_state: 'direct_active' } : r
        )
      );
      return;
    }
    if (row.ui_state === 'available') {
      setShowGrantDialog(row);
      setGrantExpiresAt('');
      setGrantNote('');
      return;
    }
    if (row.ui_state === 'pending_grant') {
      setRows((prev) =>
        prev.map((r) =>
          r.permission_id === row.permission_id
            ? { ...r, ui_state: 'available', pending_expires_at: null, pending_note: '' }
            : r
        )
      );
    }
  };

  const confirmGrantDialog = () => {
    if (!showGrantDialog) return;
    setRows((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) =>
        r.permission_id === showGrantDialog.permission_id
          ? {
              ...r,
              ui_state: 'pending_grant',
              pending_expires_at: grantExpiresAt || null,
              pending_note: grantNote,
            }
          : r
      )
    );
    setShowGrantDialog(null);
  };

  const handleSelectAllSubGroup = (subRows: PermissionRow[]) => {
    const available = subRows.filter((r) => r.ui_state === 'available');
    if (available.length === 0) return;
    setRows((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) =>
        available.some((a) => a.permission_id === r.permission_id)
          ? { ...r, ui_state: 'pending_grant', pending_expires_at: null, pending_note: '' }
          : r
      )
    );
    onToast(`Đã chọn ${available.length} quyền chờ lưu.`, 'success');
  };

  const handleScrollToGroup = (groupCode: string) => {
    setExpandedGroups((prev) => new Set(prev).add(groupCode));
    setTimeout(() => {
      groupRefs.current[groupCode]?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }, 50);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    const grants = rows.filter((r) => r.ui_state === 'pending_grant');
    const revokes = rows.filter((r) => r.ui_state === 'pending_revoke');

    if (grants.length === 0 && revokes.length === 0) {
      onToast('Không có thay đổi nào', 'info');
      onClose();
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      for (const g of grants) {
        await permissionService.grantUserPermission(user.user_id, g.permission_id, {
          expires_at: g.pending_expires_at || null,
          note: g.pending_note || undefined,
        });
      }
      for (const r of revokes) {
        await permissionService.revokeUserPermission(user.user_id, r.permission_id);
      }
      onToast(`Đã lưu: +${grants.length} grant, -${revokes.length} revoke`, 'success');
      onSaved();
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      onToast('Lỗi lưu: ' + err.message, 'error');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (!open || !user) return null;

  const isAdminUser = (user.roles || []).includes('ROL-01');

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onCancel={onClose}
        width={1080}
        centered
        footer={null}
        destroyOnHidden
        title={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-500/15 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
              <Shield className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Gán Quyền Trực Tiếp</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                {user.full_name} ({user.user_id})
                {user.rank_name && <> • {user.rank_name}</>}
                {user.position && <> • {user.position}</>}
                {user.clearance_name && (
                  <> • <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold">{user.clearance_name}</span></>
                )}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        }
      >
        {loading ? (
          <div className="py-16 flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
            <Spin size="large" />
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Đang tải danh mục quyền...</span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-3">
            {isAdminUser && (
              <Alert
                type="warning"
                showIcon
                icon={<AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />}
                message={<span className="text-xs font-semibold">Tài khoản có vai trò Admin (ROL-01) — đã bypass toàn quyền</span>}
                description={<span className="text-[11px]">Các grant bên dưới chỉ dự phòng khi bị gỡ vai trò Admin. Hệ thống vẫn bỏ qua danh sách quyền khi là Admin.</span>}
              />
            )}

            {/* 4 KPI */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
              <StatBox icon={<Lock className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Từ vai trò" value={stats.fromRole} color="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" bg="bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/30" />
              <StatBox icon={<Zap className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Trực tiếp" value={stats.direct} color="text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" bg="bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-500/10 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/30" />
              <StatBox icon={<CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Đang hiệu lực" value={stats.effective} color="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" bg="bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/30" />
              <StatBox icon={<Minus className="w-4 h-4" />} label="Có thể thêm" value={stats.available} color="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400" bg="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600/40" />
            </div>

            {/* Toolbar */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <div className="inline-flex rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-0.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                {([
                  { k: 'all',       l: `Tất cả (${rows.length})` },
                  { k: 'role',      l: `Từ role (${stats.fromRole})` },
                  { k: 'direct',    l: `Trực tiếp (${stats.direct})` },
                  { k: 'available', l: `Chưa cấp (${stats.available})` },
                ] as const).map(({ k, l }) => (
                  <button
                    key={k}
                    onClick={() => setTab(k)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition ${
                      tab === k
                        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-sm'
                        : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {l}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              <Input
                placeholder="Tìm mã quyền / mô tả..."
                prefix={<Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />}
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                allowClear
                className="flex-1 min-w-[220px]"
                size="middle"
              />

              <button
                onClick={() => setExpandedGroups(new Set(groupedData.map((g) => g.group_code)))}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
              >
                Mở rộng
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setExpandedGroups(new Set())}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
              >
                Thu gọn
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Group pills nav */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-1">
              {groupedData.map(({ group_code, total }) => {
                const cfg = GROUP_CONFIG[group_code] || GROUP_CONFIG.SYSTEM;
                const Icon = cfg.icon;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={group_code}
                    onClick={() => handleScrollToGroup(group_code)}
                    className={`shrink-0 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold border transition ${cfg.bg} ${cfg.border} ${cfg.color} hover:shadow-sm`}
                  >
                    <Icon className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>{cfg.label}</span>
                    <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/60 dark:bg-black/20 text-[10px] font-mono">{total}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* 2 tầng: Group → Sub-group */}
            <div className="max-h-[48vh] overflow-y-auto pr-1 space-y-2">
              {groupedData.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-12 text-center">
                  <Empty description="Không có quyền nào khớp bộ lọc" />
                </div>
              ) : (
                groupedData.map(({ group_code, subgroups }) => {
                  const cfg = GROUP_CONFIG[group_code] || GROUP_CONFIG.SYSTEM;
                  const Icon = cfg.icon;
                  const isExpanded = expandedGroups.has(group_code);

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={group_code}
                      ref={(el) => { groupRefs.current[group_code] = el; }}
                      className="border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/40"
                    >
                      <button
                        onClick={() => toggleExpand(group_code)}
                        className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 ${cfg.bg} hover:brightness-95 transition`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          {isExpanded ? (
                            <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 ${cfg.color}`} />
                          ) : (
                            <ChevronRight className={`w-4 h-4 ${cfg.color}`} />
                          )}
                          <div className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-lg ${cfg.bg} ${cfg.border} border flex items-center justify-center ${cfg.color}`}>
                            <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-left">
                            <div className={`font-bold text-xs ${cfg.color}`}>
                              {cfg.label}{' '}
                              <span className="font-normal opacity-70">
                                ({subgroups.reduce((s, sg) => s + sg.rows.length, 0)} quyền / {subgroups.length} phân loại)
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">{cfg.description}</div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </button>

                      {isExpanded && (
                        <div className="p-2 space-y-2">
                          {subgroups.map(({ key, info, rows: subRows }) => {
                            const tone = SUBGROUP_TONE_STYLE[info.tone];
                            const subAvailable = subRows.filter((r) => r.ui_state === 'available').length;
                            const subActive = subRows.filter(
                              (r) => r.ui_state !== 'available' && r.ui_state !== 'pending_revoke'
                            ).length;

                            return (
                              <div key={key} className={`rounded-lg border ${tone.border} ${tone.bg} overflow-hidden`}>
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5">
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${tone.dot}`} />
                                    <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${tone.text}`}>{info.label}</span>
                                    {info.mixedTone && (
                                      <Tooltip title="Phân loại này chứa cả quyền 'xem' và 'chỉnh sửa'">
                                        <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                                          2 mức
                                        </span>
                                      </Tooltip>
                                    )}
                                    <span className={`text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono border ${tone.badge}`}>
                                      {subActive}/{subRows.length}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                  {subAvailable > 0 && (
                                    <button
                                      onClick={() => handleSelectAllSubGroup(subRows)}
                                      className={`text-[10px] font-semibold ${tone.text} hover:underline px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-white/50 dark:hover:bg-black/20`}
                                    >
                                      + Chọn {subAvailable}
                                    </button>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                                <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800/40">
                                  {subRows.map((row) => (
                                    <PermissionItem
                                      key={row.permission_id}
                                      row={row}
                                      onToggle={() => handleTogglePermission(row)}
                                    />
                                  ))}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            );
                          })}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Footer */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div className="text-xs flex items-center gap-3">
                {stats.pendingGrants > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                    +{stats.pendingGrants} thêm
                  </span>
                )}
                {stats.pendingRevokes > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-semibold">
                    -{stats.pendingRevokes} gỡ
                  </span>
                )}
                {stats.pendingGrants === 0 && stats.pendingRevokes === 0 && (
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Không có thay đổi</span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"
                >
                  Hủy
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleSave}
                  disabled={saving || (stats.pendingGrants === 0 && stats.pendingRevokes === 0)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  {saving ? 'Đang lưu...' : `Lưu ${stats.pendingGrants + stats.pendingRevokes} thay đổi`}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>

      {/* Dialog con: chọn thời hạn + note khi grant */}
      <Modal
        open={Boolean(showGrantDialog)}
        onCancel={() => setShowGrantDialog(null)}
        width={460}
        centered
        zIndex={1050}
        title={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
            <span className="font-bold text-sm">Cấp quyền: {showGrantDialog?.code}</span>
          </div>
        }
        footer={[
          <button
            key="cancel"
            onClick={() => setShowGrantDialog(null)}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            Hủy
          </button>,
          <button
            key="ok"
            onClick={confirmGrantDialog}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white text-xs font-bold"
          >
            Xác nhận
          </button>,
        ]}
      >
        <div className="py-3 space-y-3 text-xs">
          <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">{showGrantDialog?.description}</p>
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-1 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              Ngày hết hạn (để trống = vĩnh viễn)
            </label>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={grantExpiresAt}
              min={new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)}
              onChange={(e) => setGrantExpiresAt(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-sm"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-1 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              Ghi chú (tùy chọn)
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={grantNote}
              onChange={(e) => setGrantNote(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="VD: Cấp tạm cho nhiệm vụ đặc biệt..."
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-sm"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SUB-COMPONENTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const StatBox: React.FC<{
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: number;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
}> = ({ icon, label, value, color, bg }) => (
  <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border ${bg}`}>
    <div className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${color} text-[11px] font-semibold`}>
      {icon}
      <span>{label}</span>
    </div>
    <div className={`text-xl font-bold mt-1 ${color}`}>{value}</div>
  </div>
);

const PermissionItem: React.FC<{
  row: PermissionRow;
  onToggle: () => void;
}> = ({ row, onToggle }) => {
  const isDangerous = DANGEROUS_CODES.has(row.code || '');
  const isPendingGrant = row.ui_state === 'pending_grant';
  const isPendingRevoke = row.ui_state === 'pending_revoke';
  const isInherited = row.ui_state === 'inherited';
  const isDirectActive = row.ui_state === 'direct_active';
  const isBoth = row.source === 'both';

  const checked = isInherited || isDirectActive || isPendingGrant || isBoth;
  const disabled = isInherited;

  return (
    <div
      className={`px-3 py-2 flex items-start gap-2.5 transition ${
        isPendingGrant ? 'bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-500/5'
        : isPendingRevoke ? 'bg-rose-50/60 dark:bg-rose-500/5'
        : isInherited ? 'bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-slate-800/20'
        : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40'
      }`}
    >
      <button
        onClick={onToggle}
        disabled={disabled}
        className={`mt-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded border-2 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center transition ${
          disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : 'cursor-pointer'
        } ${
          isPendingRevoke ? 'bg-rose-500 border-rose-500 text-white'
          : checked ? 'bg-purple-600 border-purple-600 text-white'
          : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600'
        }`}
        title={disabled ? 'Quyền này kế thừa từ vai trò' : 'Bấm để thay đổi'}
      >
        {isPendingRevoke ? (
          <X className="w-3 h-3" />
        ) : checked ? (
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
        ) : null}
      </button>

      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          <span
            className={`font-mono text-[11px] font-bold ${
              isDangerous ? 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400' : 'text-slate-900 dark:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {row.code}
          </span>

          {isInherited && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-semibold bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30">
              <Lock className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> Từ role
            </span>
          )}
          {isDirectActive && row.source === 'direct' && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-semibold bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-500/30">
              <Zap className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> Trực tiếp
            </span>
          )}
          {isBoth && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-semibold bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-100 to-purple-100 dark:from-amber-500/20 dark:to-purple-500/20 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-500/30">
              <Lock className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />+<Zap className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> Cả 2
            </span>
          )}
          {isPendingGrant && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-semibold bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30">
              + Sẽ thêm
            </span>
          )}
          {isPendingRevoke && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-semibold bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30">
              - Sẽ gỡ
            </span>
          )}

          {Boolean(row.is_system) && (
            <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600">
              🏷️ Hệ thống
            </span>
          )}

          {isDangerous && (
            <Tooltip title="Quyền này có thể gây mất dữ liệu — chỉ cấp khi thực sự cần">
              <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30">
                ⚠️ Nguy hiểm
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          )}

          {isDirectActive && row.direct_grant?.expires_at && (
            <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-400 border border-orange-300 dark:border-orange-500/30">
              ⏰ {new Date(row.direct_grant.expires_at).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')}
            </span>
          )}
          {isPendingGrant && row.pending_expires_at && (
            <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30">
              ⏰ {new Date(row.pending_expires_at).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5 line-clamp-2">
          {row.description || '—'}
        </div>

        {isInherited && row.role_sources && row.role_sources.length > 0 && (
          <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400/80 mt-0.5">
            Qua vai trò: {row.role_sources.map((r) => r.role_name).join(', ')}
          </div>
        )}

        {isDirectActive && row.direct_grant && (
          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Cấp bởi {row.direct_grant.granted_by || 'hệ thống'} •{' '}
            {new Date(row.direct_grant.granted_at).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')}
            {row.direct_grant.note && <> • &quot;{row.direct_grant.note}&quot;</>}
          </div>
        )}

        {isPendingRevoke && isBoth && (
          <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 mt-0.5 font-medium">
            ⚠️ Sau khi gỡ direct, quyền vẫn còn qua vai trò
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GrantPermissionModal;

import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { KeyRound, Copy, Check, RefreshCw, X, Loader2, AlertTriangle, KeySquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { userService } from '../../services/userService';
import { User } from '../../types/user';

export interface PinManageModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  user: User | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onChanged?: () => void;
  onToast: (msg: string, type?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info') => void;
}

export const PinManageModal: React.FC<PinManageModalProps> = ({
  open, user, onClose, onChanged, onToast,
}) => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [newPin, setNewPin] = useState('');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  // ✅ state mới: lưu lỗi để hiển thị ngay trên modal
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState('');

  const hasPin = user?.has_pin === true;

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(''); // ✅ Reset lỗi trước mỗi lần sinh PIN
    try {
      const res = await userService.generatePin(user.user_id);
      setNewPin(res.pin);
      onToast(`Đã cấp PIN mới cho ${res.full_name}. Hãy ghi lại và trao trực tiếp!`, 'success');
      onChanged?.();
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = err.message || 'Lỗi sinh PIN';
      setErrorMsg(msg);         // ✅ Hiển thị lỗi trực tiếp trên modal (phòng khi toast bị khuất)
      onToast(msg, 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (!newPin) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(newPin);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setNewPin('');
    setCopied(false);
    setErrorMsg(''); // ✅ Reset lỗi khi đóng
    onClose();
  };

  if (!open || !user) return null;

  const modal = (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[120] flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          onClick={loading ? undefined : handleClose}
          className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-md"
        />
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 12, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 26, mass: 0.75 }}
          className="relative w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#0c1420]/95 border border-cyan-200 dark:border-cyan-500/30"
        >
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center bg-cyan-50 dark:bg-cyan-500/15 border border-cyan-300 dark:border-cyan-400/40 text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300">
                <KeyRound className="w-5 h-5" strokeWidth={2.2} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Quản Lý Mã PIN</h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] mt-0.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {user.full_name} ({user.user_id})
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button" onClick={handleClose} disabled={loading}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {!newPin ? (
            <>
              {/* Trạng thái */}
              <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-3 mb-4 ${
                hasPin
                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30'
                  : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700'
              }`}>
                <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center ${
                  hasPin
                    ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300'
                    : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-500'
                }`}>
                  <KeySquare className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className={`text-xs font-bold ${
                    hasPin ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'
                  }`}>
                    {hasPin ? 'Đã cấp PIN' : 'Chưa cấp PIN'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] mt-0.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-500">
                    {hasPin ? 'Quân nhân đã có thể mở tài liệu Cấp 4-5' : 'Quân nhân sẽ bị chặn khi mở Cấp 4-5'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ✅ Hiển thị lỗi trực tiếp trên modal (phòng khi toast bị khuất) */}
              {errorMsg && (
                <div className="p-3 mb-3 rounded-xl border flex items-start gap-2 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 text-[11px]">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span><strong>Lỗi:</strong> {errorMsg}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="button" onClick={handleGenerate} disabled={loading}
                className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white transition cursor-pointer active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#14532d] via-[#166534] to-[#15803d] hover:from-[#166534] hover:to-[#15803d] border border-amber-500/30 shadow-md"
              >
                {loading ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                <span>{hasPin ? 'Random PIN mới (ghi đè PIN cũ)' : 'Random PIN mới'}</span>
              </button>

              <div className="mt-3 text-[10px] px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <strong>Lưu ý:</strong> Hệ thống chỉ random PIN 6 số, không cho nhập tay. PIN chỉ hiển thị 1 lần duy nhất.
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border text-center mb-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/40">
                <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold mb-2 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  MÃ PIN MỚI CỦA QUÂN NHÂN
                </div>
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-[0.4em] font-mono tabular-nums py-3 text-emerald-900 dark:text-white">
                  {newPin}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button" onClick={handleCopy}
                  className="mt-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold transition cursor-pointer bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
                >
                  {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copied ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] px-3 py-2 rounded-lg mb-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <span><strong>Chỉ hiển thị 1 lần!</strong> Ghi lại và trao <strong>trực tiếp</strong> cho quân nhân. Không thể khôi phục PIN này.</span>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button" onClick={handleClose}
                className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white transition cursor-pointer active:scale-95 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#14532d] via-[#166534] to-[#15803d] hover:from-[#166534] hover:to-[#15803d] border border-amber-500/30 shadow-md"
              >
                Đã ghi lại — Đóng
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined' ? createPortal(modal, document.body) : modal;
};

export default PinManageModal;

File: frontend/src/components/users/PinVerifyModal.tsx

import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Lock, ShieldCheck, KeyRound, X, Loader2, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { pinService } from '../../services/pinService';
import { userService } from '../../services/userService';
import { toast } from '../common/Toast';

export interface PinVerifyModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  pinChallengeToken: string;
  securityLevelId: number;
  documentLabel?: string;
  onSuccess: (fingerprintToken: string) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

const PIN_LENGTH = 6;

export const PinVerifyModal: React.FC<PinVerifyModalProps> = ({
  open,
  pinChallengeToken,
  securityLevelId,
  documentLabel,
  onSuccess,
  onCancel,
}) => {
  const [digits, setDigits] = useState<string[]>(Array(PIN_LENGTH).fill(''));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [shakeKey, setShakeKey] = useState(0);
  const [pinRequestSending, setPinRequestSending] = useState(false);
  const inputsRef = useRef<Array<HTMLInputElement | null>>([]);

  // ✅ Nhận diện lỗi rate-limit (khớp message "Quá nhiều lần nhập mã PIN...")
  const isRateLimitError = /quá nhiều|rate.?limit|thử lại sau/i.test(error);

  // Reset state khi mở modal
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setDigits(Array(PIN_LENGTH).fill(''));
      setError('');
      setLoading(false);
      setPinRequestSending(false);
      setTimeout(() => inputsRef.current[0]?.focus(), 200);
    }
  }, [open]);

  // Safety-net: khi modal đóng (open true → false), ép blur ô input đang focus
  // để password manager không cache giá trị PIN
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
        document.activeElement.blur();
      }
    }
  }, [open]);

  const handleChange = (index: number, value: string) => {
    if (!/^\d*$/.test(value)) return;
    if (error) setError('');
    const char = value.slice(-1);
    const next = [...digits];
    next[index] = char;
    setDigits(next);
    if (char && index < PIN_LENGTH - 1) inputsRef.current[index + 1]?.focus();
    if (next.every((d) => d) && char) void submit(next.join(''));
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (index: number, e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !digits[index] && index > 0) inputsRef.current[index - 1]?.focus();
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && index > 0) inputsRef.current[index - 1]?.focus();
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && index < PIN_LENGTH - 1) inputsRef.current[index + 1]?.focus();
  };

  const handlePaste = (e: React.ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const text = e.clipboardData.getData('text').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, PIN_LENGTH);
    if (text.length === PIN_LENGTH) {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDigits(text.split(''));
      void submit(text);
    }
  };

  const submit = useCallback(
    async (value: string) => {
      if (loading) return;
      if (value.length !== PIN_LENGTH) {
        setError('Mã PIN phải đủ 6 chữ số');
        setShakeKey((k) => k + 1);
        return;
      }
      setLoading(true);
      setError('');
      try {
        const res = await pinService.verify(pinChallengeToken, value);
        if (res.success && res.fingerprint_token) {
          // ✅ Blur trước khi bàn giao token → tránh browser "nhớ" ô PIN
          if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
            document.activeElement.blur();
          }
          setDigits(Array(PIN_LENGTH).fill(''));
          onSuccess(res.fingerprint_token);
        } else {
          throw new Error('Không nhận được token sau xác thực PIN');
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err?.message || 'Xác thực PIN thất bại');
        setShakeKey((k) => k + 1);
        setDigits(Array(PIN_LENGTH).fill(''));
        setTimeout(() => inputsRef.current[0]?.focus(), 100);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [loading, pinChallengeToken, onSuccess]
  );

  // ✅ Đóng modal AN TOÀN: blur + clear trước khi gọi onCancel
  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
      document.activeElement.blur();
    }
    setDigits(Array(PIN_LENGTH).fill(''));
    setError('');
    onCancel();
  }, [onCancel]);

  // ✅ Gửi yêu cầu cấp lại PIN khi user quên
  const handleForgotPin = async () => {
    if (pinRequestSending || loading) return;
    setPinRequestSending(true);
    try {
      await userService.requestPin(documentLabel || '');
      toast.success('Đã gửi yêu cầu cấp lại PIN đến Admin!');
      handleClose();
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e?.message || 'Lỗi gửi yêu cầu cấp lại PIN');
      setPinRequestSending(false);
    }
  };

  if (!open) return null;

  const modal = (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[110] flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          onClick={loading ? undefined : handleClose}
          className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-md"
        />
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 16, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 26, mass: 0.75 }}
          className="relative w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#0c1420]/95 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/30"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-400/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300">
                <KeyRound className="w-5 h-5" strokeWidth={2.2} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Xác Thực Mã PIN Cấp {securityLevelId}</h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] mt-0.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {securityLevelId >= 5 ? 'TUYỆT MẬT' : 'TỐI MẬT'} · Nhập PIN 6 số do Admin cấp
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button" onClick={handleClose} disabled={loading}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] px-3 py-2 rounded-lg mb-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span>Vân tay đã hợp lệ — còn bước PIN cuối cùng</span>
          </div>

          {documentLabel && (
            <div className="text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded-lg mb-4 truncate bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <span className="font-semibold">Văn bản:</span> {documentLabel}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 6 ô PIN */}
          <div key={shakeKey} className={shakeKey > 0 ? 'animate-[pinShake_0.42s_ease-in-out]' : ''}>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-2 mb-3">
              {digits.map((d, i) => (
                <input
                  key={i}
                  ref={(el) => { inputsRef.current[i] = el; }}
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  pattern="[0-9]*"
                  autoComplete="new-password"
                  name={`pin-digit-${i}`}
                  maxLength={1}
                  value={d}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange(i, e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => handleKeyDown(i, e)}
                  onPaste={handlePaste}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className={`w-full aspect-square text-center text-xl font-bold rounded-xl border-2 font-mono tabular-nums transition-all focus:outline-none disabled:opacity-50 ${
                    error
                      ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200'
                      : d
                      ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300'
                      : 'border-slate-300 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-600/20 dark:focus:border-emerald-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-500/30'
                  }`}
                  aria-label={`Chữ số ${i + 1}`}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Hiển thị lỗi — style riêng cho rate-limit */}
          {error && (
            isRateLimitError ? (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-xl mb-3 text-xs font-semibold border border-rose-500/20 text-center">
                ⚠️ Quá nhiều lần nhập mã PIN. Vui lòng thử lại sau 1 phút.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded-lg mb-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300" role="alert">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <span>{error}</span>
              </div>
            )
          )}

          {/* ✅ Khi có lỗi → hiện khu vực "Quên PIN + Hotline" */}
          {error && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 mt-1 mb-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleForgotPin}
                disabled={loading || pinRequestSending}
                className="w-full py-2.5 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl transition shadow-md disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.98]"
              >
                {pinRequestSending ? (
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                )}
                <span>
                  {pinRequestSending ? 'Đang gửi yêu cầu...' : 'Quên mã PIN? Gửi yêu cầu cấp lại'}
                </span>
              </button>

              <p className="text-center text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
                Hoặc liên hệ Hotline Admin:{' '}
                <strong className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">0987.654.321</strong>
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mt-5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/60">
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">Bước 2/2 · PIN 6 số</div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button" onClick={handleClose} disabled={loading}
                className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                Hủy
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => void submit(digits.join(''))}
                disabled={loading || digits.join('').length !== PIN_LENGTH}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white transition cursor-pointer active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#14532d] via-[#166534] to-[#15803d] hover:from-[#166534] hover:to-[#15803d] border border-amber-500/30 shadow-md"
              >
                {loading ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                <span>Xác nhận</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined' ? createPortal(modal, document.body) : modal;
};

export default PinVerifyModal;
