// usertable.tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Pagination, Tooltip } from 'antd';
import { User } from '../../types/user';
import { useAuth } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { Pencil, KeyRound, Trash2, Fingerprint, Shield, KeySquare } from 'lucide-react';

export interface UserTableProps {
  users: User[];
  onEdit: (user: User) => void;
  onUpdateCredentials: (user: User) => void;
  onDelete: (user: User) => void;
  onEnrollFingerprint?: (user: User) => void;
  onGrantPermission?: (user: User) => void;
  onViewPermissions?: (user: User) => void;
  onUnlock?: (user: User) => void;
  loading?: boolean;
  pageSize?: number;
  // ✅ Đã thêm prop quản lý PIN
  onManagePin?: (user: User) => void; 
}

export const UserTable: React.FC<UserTableProps> = ({
  users,
  onEdit,
  onUpdateCredentials,
  onDelete,
  onEnrollFingerprint,
  onGrantPermission,
  onViewPermissions,
  onUnlock,
  loading = false,
  pageSize = 5,
  onManagePin,
}) => {
  // Lấy trạng thái quyền của user đang đăng nhập
  const { user, hasPermission } = useAuth();
  const isAdminUser = (user?.roles || []).includes('ROL-01');
  const canDeleteUser = hasPermission('USER_DELETE');

  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);

  // Tự động reset trang về 1 khi số lượng users thay đổi (do search/filter)
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [users.length]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(users.length / pageSize) || 1;
  const safeCurrentPage = Math.min(Math.max(1, currentPage), totalPages);

  const pagedUsers = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (safeCurrentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return users.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [users, safeCurrentPage, pageSize]);

  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm transition-colors duration-200">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto" style={{ WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch' }}>
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 min-w-[1060px]">
          <thead className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/90 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[11px] uppercase border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 tracking-wider">
            <tr>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">Mã</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">Họ và tên</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">Cấp bậc</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">Chức vụ</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">Vai trò</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">Đơn vị</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">Mức bảo mật</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4">Quyền</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">Trạng thái</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right whitespace-nowrap">Thao tác</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800/60 font-medium">
            {loading ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={10} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Đang tải danh sách người dùng...
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : users.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={10} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                  Không tìm thấy người dùng nào phù hợp
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              pagedUsers.map((u) => (
                <tr
                  key={u.user_id}
                  className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors"
                >
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">
                    <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-amber-800 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-600/25 dark:text-amber-400 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:border-amber-500/25 font-bold tracking-wider inline-block">
                      {u.user_id}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span>{u.full_name}</span>

                      {/* ✅ BADGE CẢNH BÁO USER ĐANG XIN CẤP PIN */}
                      {u.pin_requested && !u.has_pin && (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-rose-500 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full animate-pulse shadow-sm">
                          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white"></span>
                          Chờ cấp PIN
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                    {u.rank_name || '—'}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {u.position || '—'}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {(() => {
                      const roles = (u.role_names && u.role_names.length > 0)
                        ? u.role_names
                        : (u.roles && u.roles.length > 0)
                        ? u.roles
                        : [];
                      if (roles.length === 0) {
                        return <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600">—</span>;
                      }
                      return (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 max-w-[200px]">
                          {roles.map((rn, idx) => {
                            const isAdmin = rn.toLowerCase().includes('admin');
                            return (
                              <span
                                key={idx}
                                className={`inline-block text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded whitespace-nowrap border ${
                                  isAdmin
                                    ? 'bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-500/30'
                                    : 'bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 border-indigo-500/25'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {rn}
                              </span>
                            );
                          })}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })()}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {u.unit_name || '—'}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <span
                      className={`inline-block text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded whitespace-nowrap border ${
                        (u.clearance_level_id || 1) >= 4
                           ? 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 border-red-500/30'
                          : (u.clearance_level_id || 1) === 3
                          ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30'
                          : 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {u.clearance_name || `Mức ${u.clearance_level_id}`}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  {/* Cột Quyền — click để xem chi tiết (nếu có onViewPermissions) */}
                  <td className="py-3 px-4">
                    <div
                      className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                        onViewPermissions
                          ? 'cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition'
                          : ''
                      }`}
                      onClick={onViewPermissions ? () => onViewPermissions(u) : undefined}
                      title={onViewPermissions ? 'Xem chi tiết quyền' : undefined}
                      role={onViewPermissions ? 'button' : undefined}
                    >
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
                        {(u.permissions || []).length}
                      </span>
                      {(u.roles || []).length > 0 && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                          +{(u.roles || []).length} role
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span
                        className={`inline-block text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded whitespace-nowrap border ${
                          u.status === 'active' || !u.status
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30'
                            : 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-500/30'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {u.status === 'active' || !u.status ? 'Hoạt động' : 'Khóa'}
                      </span>
                      {u.status === 'locked' && onUnlock && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => onUnlock(u)}
                          className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/60 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300/60 transition cursor-pointer text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs"
                          title="Mở khóa tài khoản ngay"
                        >
                          <KeyRound className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                          <span>Mở</span>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    {/* 1. Nút Đăng ký / Cập nhật Vân tay */}
                    {onEnrollFingerprint && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => onEnrollFingerprint(u)}
                        className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg mr-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer btn-tactile active:scale-95 ${
                          u.has_fingerprint
                            ? 'bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/60 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/50'
                            : 'bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 border border-amber-200 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/70 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800/50'
                        }`}
                        title={
                          u.has_fingerprint
                            ? 'Đã có vân tay (Nhấn để thay thế / dán đè)'
                            : 'Chưa có vân tay (Nhấn để thêm vân tay)'
                        }
                      >
                        <Fingerprint className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}

                    {/* 2. Nút Quản lý PIN — chỉ hiện cho quân nhân Cấp ≥ 4 */}
                    {onManagePin && (u.clearance_level_id || 1) >= 4 && (
                      <Tooltip
                        title={
                          u.has_pin
                            ? '🔑 Quản lý PIN (Đã cấp) — click để random lại'
                            : '🔑 Quản lý PIN (Chưa cấp) — click để random PIN 6 số'
                        }
                        placement="top"
                      >
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onManagePin(u)}
                          className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg mr-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer btn-tactile active:scale-95 ${
                            u.has_pin
                              ? 'bg-cyan-50 hover:bg-cyan-100 border border-cyan-300 text-cyan-700 dark:bg-cyan-950/40 dark:hover:bg-cyan-900/60 dark:text-cyan-300 dark:border-cyan-800/50'
                              : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-300 text-slate-500 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 dark:border-slate-700'
                          }`}
                          aria-label={u.has_pin ? 'Quản lý PIN (đã cấp)' : 'Quản lý PIN (chưa cấp)'}
                        >
                          <KeySquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </Tooltip>
                    )}

                    {/* 3. Nút Gán quyền trực tiếp */}
                    {onGrantPermission && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => onGrantPermission(u)}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded-lg mr-1.5 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 border border-indigo-200 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/70 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-800/50 transition cursor-pointer"
                        title="Gán quyền trực tiếp"
                      >
                        <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}

                    {/* 4. Nút Sửa thông tin */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onEdit(u)}
                      className="p-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-transparent rounded-lg mr-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer btn-tactile active:scale-95"
                      title="Sửa thông tin"
                    >
                      <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>

                    {/* 5. Nút Cập nhật tài khoản & mật khẩu */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onUpdateCredentials(u)}
                      className="p-1.5 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 border border-amber-200 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/40 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/70 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-transparent rounded-lg mr-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer btn-tactile active:scale-95"
                      title="Cập nhật tài khoản & mật khẩu"
                    >
                      <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>

                    {/* 6. Nút Xóa */}
                    {canDeleteUser && (() => {
                      const needsApproval = !isAdminUser;
                      const tooltip = needsApproval
                        ? '⚠️ Yêu cầu quyền Admin để xóa — bấm để gửi yêu cầu phê duyệt'
                        : 'Xóa người dùng (đưa vào thùng rác)';

                      return (
                        <Tooltip title={tooltip} placement="top" arrow>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onDelete(u)}
                            aria-label={needsApproval ? 'Yêu cầu duyệt xóa người dùng' : 'Xóa người dùng'}
                            className={`
                              p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer
                              btn-tactile active:scale-95
                              ${
                                needsApproval
                                  ? 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-300 text-slate-500 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 dark:border-slate-700 hover:text-amber-600 dark:hover:text-amber-400'
                                  : 'bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 border border-rose-200 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/70 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border-transparent'
                              }
                            `}
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </Tooltip>
                      );
                    })()}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Phân trang */}
      {!loading && users.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-slate-900/60">
          <div className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Hiển thị <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{(safeCurrentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1}</span> -{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{Math.min(safeCurrentPage * pageSize, users.length)}</span> trên{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{users.length}</span> quân nhân
          </div>
          <Pagination
            size="small"
            current={safeCurrentPage}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            total={users.length}
            onChange={(page) => setCurrentPage(page)}
            showSizeChanger={false}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { KeyRound, Copy, CheckCircle2, ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import { http } from '../../services/http';
import { toast } from '../common/Toast';

export const UserViewPinModal = ({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean, onClose: () => void }) => {
  const [pin, setPin] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleGetPin = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res: any = await http('/api/user/my-pin');
      setPin(res.pin);
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Lỗi lấy mã PIN');
      onClose();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (!pin) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(pin);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl max-w-sm w-full p-6 text-center shadow-2xl border border-amber-500/30">
        <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-amber-100 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
          <KeyRound className="w-8 h-8" />
        </div>
        
        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-2">Mã PIN Bảo Mật Mới</h3>
        
        {!pin ? (
          <>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-6">
              Quản trị viên vừa cấp mã PIN mới cho bạn.<br/>
              <strong className="text-rose-500">Cảnh báo: Mã PIN chỉ hiển thị 1 lần duy nhất!</strong>
            </p>
            <button 
              onClick={handleGetPin}
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl transition"
            >
              {loading ? 'Đang lấy mã...' : 'Xem mã PIN ngay'}
            </button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="text-4xl font-mono tracking-[0.3em] font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 py-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 rounded-xl mb-4 border border-emerald-200">
              {pin}
            </div>
            
            <button onClick={handleCopy} className="w-full mb-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-bold rounded-xl flex justify-center items-center gap-2">
              {copied ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
              {copied ? 'Đã Copy' : 'Copy Mã PIN'}
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-left text-xs text-rose-600 bg-rose-50 p-3 rounded-lg mb-4">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0" />
              <span>Nếu đóng bảng này, bạn sẽ <strong>KHÔNG THỂ</strong> xem lại mã PIN. Hãy ghi nhớ hoặc lưu ngay.</span>
            </div>

            <button 
              onClick={() => { setPin(null); onClose(); }}
              className="w-full py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl transition"
            >
              Đã ghi nhớ - Đóng
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { Permission, SubGroupInfo, SubGroupTone } from '../types/user';

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STYLE CHO MỖI TONE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export const SUBGROUP_TONE_STYLE: Record<
  SubGroupTone,
  {
    label: string;
    dot: string;
    bg: string;
    border: string;
    text: string;
    badge: string;
  }
> = {
  read: {
    label: 'Xem / Tra cứu',
    dot: 'bg-emerald-500',
    bg: 'bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-500/5',
    border: 'border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/30',
    text: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400',
    badge:
      'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30',
  },
  write: {
    label: 'Ghi / Chỉnh sửa',
    dot: 'bg-amber-500',
    bg: 'bg-amber-50/60 dark:bg-amber-500/5',
    border: 'border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/30',
    text: 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400',
    badge:
      'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/15 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30',
  },
  security: {
    label: 'Bảo mật / Phân quyền',
    dot: 'bg-purple-500',
    bg: 'bg-purple-50/60 dark:bg-purple-500/5',
    border: 'border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/30',
    text: 'text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400',
    badge:
      'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border-purple-300 dark:bg-purple-500/15 dark:text-purple-300 dark:border-purple-500/30',
  },
  danger: {
    label: 'Nguy hiểm',
    dot: 'bg-rose-500',
    bg: 'bg-rose-50/60 dark:bg-rose-500/5',
    border: 'border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/30',
    text: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400',
    badge:
      'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-500/15 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30',
  },
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PRIORITY — tone nào "cao hơn" khi sub-group có mixed-tone
// danger > security > write > read
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export const TONE_PRIORITY: Record<SubGroupTone, number> = {
  danger: 4,
  security: 3,
  write: 2,
  read: 1,
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPER — Đọc subgroup info từ 1 permission (DB-driven)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function getSubGroupFromPermission(p: Permission): SubGroupInfo {
  return {
    key: p.subgroup_key || `custom-${p.group_code || 'system'}`,
    label: p.subgroup_label || 'Tùy chỉnh',
    order: p.subgroup_order ?? 50,
    tone: (p.subgroup_tone as SubGroupTone) || 'read',
  };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPER — Gom 1 mảng permission thành các sub-group (dùng cho tab Catalog admin)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function groupPermissionsBySubGroup<T extends Permission>(
  permissions: T[]
): Array<{ subgroup: SubGroupInfo; permissions: T[] }> {
  const map = new Map<
    string,
    { info: SubGroupInfo; perms: T[]; tones: Set<SubGroupTone> }
  >();

  for (const p of permissions) {
    const sg = getSubGroupFromPermission(p);
    if (!map.has(sg.key)) {
      map.set(sg.key, { info: sg, perms: [], tones: new Set() });
    }
    const entry = map.get(sg.key)!;
    entry.perms.push(p);
    entry.tones.add(sg.tone);
  }

  return Array.from(map.values())
    .map(({ info, perms, tones }) => {
      const tonesArr = Array.from(tones);
      const maxTone = tonesArr.reduce<SubGroupTone>(
        (acc, t) => (TONE_PRIORITY[t] > TONE_PRIORITY[acc] ? t : acc),
        'read'
      );
      return {
        subgroup: {
          ...info,
          tone: maxTone,
          mixedTone: tones.size > 1,
        },
        permissions: perms.sort((a, b) =>
          (a.code || '').localeCompare(b.code || '')
        ),
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.subgroup.order - b.subgroup.order);
}

/**
 * Tài khoản và vai trò được bảo vệ hệ thống.
 * KHÔNG THỂ gỡ các role này bằng bất kỳ cách nào.
 */
export const PROTECTED_ADMIN = {
  USER_ID: 'USR-001',
  ROLE_ID: 'ROL-01',
} as const;

/**
 * Check: roleId của userId có phải là role Admin của tài khoản bảo vệ không?
 * VD: isProtectedAdminRole('USR-001', 'ROL-01') === true
 *     isProtectedAdminRole('USR-001', 'ROL-03') === false  (gỡ role khác vẫn OK)
 *     isProtectedAdminRole('USR-002', 'ROL-01') === false  (admin khác có ROL-01? → OK, nhưng trigger trg_ProtectLastAdmin sẽ chặn)
 */
export const isProtectedAdminRole = (userId: string, roleId: string): boolean => {
  return userId === PROTECTED_ADMIN.USER_ID && roleId === PROTECTED_ADMIN.ROLE_ID;
};

/**
 * Check: user có phải là tài khoản bảo vệ không?
 * Dùng để chặn cả thao tác xóa user.
 */
export const isProtectedUser = (userId: string): boolean => {
  return userId === PROTECTED_ADMIN.USER_ID;
};

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, ReactNode } from 'react';

export interface AIChatContextType {
  isChatOpen: boolean;
  setIsChatOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  openChat: () => void;
  closeChat: () => void;
  toggleChat: () => void;
  aiStatus: 'online' | 'fallback' | 'checking';
  setAiStatus: (status: 'online' | 'fallback' | 'checking') => void;
}

const AIChatContext = createContext<AIChatContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AIChatProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [isChatOpen, setIsChatOpen] = useState(false);
  const [aiStatus, setAiStatus] = useState<'online' | 'fallback' | 'checking'>('checking');

  const openChat = useCallback(() => setIsChatOpen(true), []);
  const closeChat = useCallback(() => setIsChatOpen(false), []);
  const toggleChat = useCallback(() => setIsChatOpen((prev) => !prev), []);

  return (
    <AIChatContext.Provider
      value={{
        isChatOpen,
        setIsChatOpen,
        openChat,
        closeChat,
        toggleChat,
        aiStatus,
        setAiStatus,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AIChatContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAIChat = (): AIChatContextType => {
  const ctx = useContext(AIChatContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    throw new Error('useAIChat must be used within an AIChatProvider');
  }
  return ctx;
};

// frontend/src/contexts/ApprovalContext.tsx
/**
 * ApprovalContext — Quản lý tập trung số lượng yêu cầu chờ duyệt
 *
 * Lý do tạo context thay vì mỗi component tự poll:
 *   1. Chỉ 1 timer duy nhất → tránh 2 (Header) + 1 (Sidebar) + 1 (AdminDashboard) = 4 timer song song
 *   2. Đảm bảo mọi nơi hiển thị cùng 1 con số
 *   3. Tự động bật/tắt poll theo trạng thái auth + permission
 *   4. Cung cấp `refresh()` để các trang chủ động làm mới sau khi approve/reject
 *
 * Quy tắc bật poll:
 *   - isAuthenticated === true (không phải GUEST)
 *   - có permission 'AUDIT_VIEW' (chỉ Admin/Quản trị tối cao mới thấy)
 */
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useCallback,
  ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { approvalService } from '../services/approvalService';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';

export interface ApprovalContextValue {
  /** Số lượng yêu cầu đang chờ duyệt (status = PENDING) */
  count: number;
  /** Đang trong chu kỳ fetch (dùng cho spinner) */
  isPolling: boolean;
  /** Buộc làm mới ngay lập tức (sau khi approve/reject) */
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

const ApprovalContext = createContext<ApprovalContextValue>({
  count: 0,
  isPolling: false,
  refresh: async () => {},
});

export const useApprovalContext = (): ApprovalContextValue =>
  useContext(ApprovalContext);

export interface ApprovalProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Chu kỳ poll (ms). Mặc định 30s */
  pollMs?: number;
}

export const ApprovalProvider: React.FC<ApprovalProviderProps> = ({
  children,
  pollMs = 30000,
}) => {
  const { user, hasPermission } = useAuth();

  // ─── Điều kiện bật poll ───
  const isAuthenticated = !!user && user.user_id !== 'GUEST';
  const canApprove = hasPermission('APPROVAL_VALIDATE');
  const enabled = isAuthenticated && canApprove;

  const [count, setCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isPolling, setIsPolling] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!enabled) {
      setCount(0);
      return;
    }
    try {
      setIsPolling(true);
      const res = await approvalService.listPending();
      setCount(res.items?.length || 0);
    } catch {
      // silent — không dispatch toast để tránh spam
      // Nếu lỗi 401 → HttpErrorListener đã xử lý
    } finally {
      setIsPolling(false);
    }
  }, [enabled]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) {
      setCount(0);
      return;
    }

    // Fetch ngay lần đầu
    refresh();

    // Poll định kỳ
    const timer = pollMs > 0 ? setInterval(refresh, pollMs) : null;
    return () => { if (timer) clearInterval(timer); };
  }, [enabled, pollMs, refresh]);

  return (
    <ApprovalContext.Provider value={{ count, isPolling, refresh }}>
      {children}
    </ApprovalContext.Provider>
  );
};

export default ApprovalContext;

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { User } from '../types/user';
import { authService } from '../services/authService';
import { ROUTE_PATHS } from '../routes/routePaths';

interface AuthContextType {
  user: User | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  isStaff: boolean;
  isManager: boolean;
  isGuest: boolean;
  roles: string[];
  role_names: string[];
  permissions: string[];
  hasRole: (roleOrName: string) => boolean;
  hasPermission: (code: string) => boolean;
  hasAnyPermission: (codes: string[]) => boolean;
  hasAllPermissions: (codes: string[]) => boolean;
  login: (userId: string, password: string) => Promise<User>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  continueAsGuest: () => void;
  saveUserSession: (user: User) => void;
  refreshProfile: () => Promise<User | null>;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const isUserAdmin = (user: User | null): boolean => {
  if (!user || user.user_id === 'GUEST') return false;
  const roles = user.roles || [];
  const roleNames = user.role_names || [];
  return (
    roles.includes('ROL-01') ||
    roles.some((r) => r.toLowerCase() === 'admin') ||
    roleNames.some((n) => n.toLowerCase().includes('admin') || n.toLowerCase().includes('quản trị'))
  );
};

export const isUserStaff = (user: User | null): boolean => {
  if (!user || user.user_id === 'GUEST') return false;
  const roles = user.roles || [];
  const roleNames = user.role_names || [];
  return (
    roles.includes('ROL-04') || roles.includes('ROL-07') ||
    roleNames.some((n) => {
      const l = n.toLowerCase();
      return l.includes('thư ký') || l.includes('văn thư') || l.includes('staff');
    })
  );
};

export const isUserManager = (user: User | null): boolean => {
  if (!user || user.user_id === 'GUEST') return false;
  const roles = user.roles || [];
  const roleNames = user.role_names || [];
  return (
    roles.includes('ROL-02') ||
    roleNames.some((n) => {
      const l = n.toLowerCase();
      return l.includes('chỉ huy') || l.includes('thủ trưởng') || l.includes('trưởng phòng');
    })
  );
};

export const getDestinationByRole = (user: User | null): string => {
  if (!user || user.user_id === 'GUEST') return ROUTE_PATHS.PORTAL;
  if (isUserAdmin(user)) return ROUTE_PATHS.ADMIN;
  if (isUserStaff(user)) return ROUTE_PATHS.DESK;
  return ROUTE_PATHS.PORTAL;
};

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(() => authService.getCurrentSession());
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const saveUserSession = useCallback((userData: User) => {
    authService.saveSession(userData);
    setUser(userData);
  }, []);

  const refreshProfile = useCallback(async (): Promise<User | null> => {
    const current = authService.getCurrentSession();
    if (!current || current.user_id === 'GUEST') return null;
    try {
      const fresh = await authService.getMe();
      if (fresh && fresh.user_id) {
        saveUserSession(fresh);
        return fresh;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[AuthProvider] refreshProfile:', err);
    }
    return current;
  }, [saveUserSession]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const session = authService.getCurrentSession();
    setUser(session);
    if (session && session.user_id !== 'GUEST' && (!session.permissions || session.permissions.length === 0)) {
      refreshProfile().catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [refreshProfile]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleExpired = () => {
      authService.clearSession();
      setUser(null);
      navigate(ROUTE_PATHS.LOGIN, { replace: true });
    };
    window.addEventListener('qk7:session-expired', handleExpired);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('qk7:session-expired', handleExpired);
  }, [navigate]);

  const login = useCallback(async (userId: string, password: string) => {
    const res = await authService.login(userId, password);
    if (res.success && res.user) {
      saveUserSession(res.user);
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          sessionStorage.removeItem('qk7_screenshot_violation_count');
          sessionStorage.removeItem('qk7_account_locked_screenshot');
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      return res.user;
    }
    throw new Error('Đăng nhập thất bại');
  }, [saveUserSession]);

  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    await authService.logout();
    setUser(null);
    navigate(ROUTE_PATHS.LOGIN);

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        Object.keys(sessionStorage)
          .filter(k => k.startsWith('qk7_fp_token'))
          .forEach(k => sessionStorage.removeItem(k));
        sessionStorage.removeItem('qk7_screenshot_violation_count');
        sessionStorage.removeItem('qk7_account_locked_screenshot');
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }, [navigate]);

  const continueAsGuest = useCallback(() => {
    authService.clearSession();
    const guest: User = {
      user_id: 'GUEST',
      full_name: 'Đại biểu',
      clearance_level_id: 1,
      clearance_name: 'Công khai',
      permissions: [],
    };
    setUser(guest);
    navigate(ROUTE_PATHS.PORTAL);
  }, [navigate]);

  const isAuthenticated = !!user && user.user_id !== 'GUEST';
  const isAdmin = isUserAdmin(user);
  const isManager = isUserManager(user);
  const isStaff = isUserStaff(user);
  const isGuest = !user || user.user_id === 'GUEST';
  const roles = user?.roles || [];
  const role_names = user?.role_names || [];
  const permissions = user?.permissions || [];
  const isAdminBypass = roles.includes('ROL-01');

  const hasRole = useCallback((roleOrName: string) => {
    if (!user) return false;
    const l = roleOrName.toLowerCase();
    return (
      (user.roles || []).some((r) => r.toLowerCase() === l) ||
      (user.role_names || []).some((n) => n.toLowerCase() === l)
    );
  }, [user]);

  const hasPermission = useCallback((code: string) => {
    if (!user) return false;
    if (isAdminBypass) return true;        // ⭐ Admin bypass
    return (user.permissions || []).includes(code);
  }, [user, isAdminBypass]);

  const hasAnyPermission = useCallback((codes: string[]) => {
    if (!user) return false;
    if (isAdminBypass) return true;
    return codes.some((c) => (user.permissions || []).includes(c));
  }, [user, isAdminBypass]);

  const hasAllPermissions = useCallback((codes: string[]) => {
    if (!user) return false;
    if (isAdminBypass) return true;
    return codes.every((c) => (user.permissions || []).includes(c));
  }, [user, isAdminBypass]);

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user, isAuthenticated, isAdmin, isStaff, isManager, isGuest,
        roles, role_names, permissions,
        hasRole, hasPermission, hasAnyPermission, hasAllPermissions,
        login, logout, continueAsGuest, saveUserSession, refreshProfile,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export function useAuthContext(): AuthContextType {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuthContext phải được dùng trong AuthProvider');
  return ctx;
}

export const useAuth = useAuthContext;

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, ReactNode } from 'react';

export type DeviceMode = 'pc' | 'ipad';
export type ScreenOrientation = 'landscape' | 'portrait';

export interface DeviceInfo {
  deviceMode: DeviceMode;
  orientation: ScreenOrientation;
  aspectRatio: number;
  browserName: string;
  isAutoDetected: boolean;
  screenWidth: number;
  screenHeight: number;
  isTouch: boolean;
}

export interface DeviceModeContextType extends DeviceInfo {
  setManualDeviceMode: (mode: DeviceMode) => void;
  resetToAutoDetect: () => void;
  toggleDeviceMode: () => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'qk7_manual_device_mode';

/**
 * Nhận diện chính xác tên trình duyệt web trên iPadOS và Desktop
 */
export const detectBrowserName = (ua: string = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.userAgent : ''): string => {
  const lowerUA = ua.toLowerCase();

  if (lowerUA.includes('coccoc') || lowerUA.includes('coc_coc')) {
    return 'Cốc Cốc';
  }
  if (lowerUA.includes('gsa/')) {
    return 'Google App';
  }
  if (lowerUA.includes('crios')) {
    return 'Google Chrome';
  }
  if (lowerUA.includes('edgios') || lowerUA.includes('edg/')) {
    return 'Microsoft Edge';
  }
  if (lowerUA.includes('fxios') || lowerUA.includes('firefox')) {
    return 'Firefox';
  }
  if (lowerUA.includes('chrome') && !lowerUA.includes('chromium')) {
    return 'Google Chrome';
  }
  if (lowerUA.includes('safari') && !lowerUA.includes('chrome') && !lowerUA.includes('crios')) {
    return 'Safari';
  }

  return 'Trình duyệt Web';
};

/**
 * Thuật toán Tự động Nhận diện Thiết Bị & Tỉ Lệ Khung Hình Thông Minh
 */
export const detectSmartDeviceAndRatio = (): {
  deviceMode: DeviceMode;
  orientation: ScreenOrientation;
  aspectRatio: number;
  browserName: string;
  screenWidth: number;
  screenHeight: number;
  isTouch: boolean;
} => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return {
      deviceMode: 'pc',
      orientation: 'landscape',
      aspectRatio: 1.78,
      browserName: 'Desktop',
      screenWidth: 1920,
      screenHeight: 1080,
      isTouch: false,
    };
  }

  const w = window.innerWidth;
  const h = window.innerHeight;
  const aspectRatio = Number((w / h).toFixed(2));
  const orientation: ScreenOrientation = w >= h ? 'landscape' : 'portrait';
  const ua = navigator.userAgent;
  const browserName = detectBrowserName(ua);

  const maxTouchPoints = navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0;
  const isTouch = maxTouchPoints >= 2 || 'ontouchstart' in window;

  const isIPadUA = /iPad/i.test(ua);
  const isMacintoshTouch = /Macintosh/i.test(ua) && maxTouchPoints >= 2;
  const isIOSBrowser = /CriOS|GSA|CocCoc/i.test(ua) && isTouch;

  const maxDim = Math.max(w, h);
  const minDim = Math.min(w, h);

  const isTabletDimensions = maxDim <= 1366 && minDim >= 700;
  const isTabletAspectRatio = orientation === 'portrait' || aspectRatio <= 1.58;

  let isDetectedAsIPad = false;

  if (maxTouchPoints === 0 && w > 1024) {
    isDetectedAsIPad = false;
  } else if ((isIPadUA || isMacintoshTouch || isIOSBrowser) && (isTabletDimensions || isTabletAspectRatio)) {
    isDetectedAsIPad = true;
  } else if (isTouch && w <= 1366 && isTabletAspectRatio) {
    isDetectedAsIPad = true;
  } else if (w <= 1024 && isTabletAspectRatio) {
    isDetectedAsIPad = true;
  }

  return {
    deviceMode: isDetectedAsIPad ? 'ipad' : 'pc',
    orientation,
    aspectRatio,
    browserName,
    screenWidth: w,
    screenHeight: h,
    isTouch,
  };
};

/**
 * Đọc setting từ localStorage.
 * Migrate 1 lần: nếu localStorage trống nhưng sessionStorage cũ có giá trị thì copy sang.
 */
const readSavedMode = (): DeviceMode | null => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved === 'pc' || saved === 'ipad') {
      return saved as DeviceMode;
    }
    // Migrate từ sessionStorage (version cũ)
    const legacy = sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (legacy === 'pc' || legacy === 'ipad') {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, legacy);
      sessionStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return legacy as DeviceMode;
    }
  } catch {
    // storage unavailable
  }
  return null;
};

const DeviceModeContext = createContext<DeviceModeContextType | null>(null);

export const DeviceModeProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  // Đọc cài đặt thủ công từ localStorage nếu có (kèm migrate từ sessionStorage)
  const [manualMode, setManualMode] = useState<DeviceMode | null>(() => readSavedMode());

  const [autoInfo, setAutoInfo] = useState(() => detectSmartDeviceAndRatio());

  // Lắng nghe resize và orientationchange để cập nhật liên tục
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleUpdate = () => {
      setAutoInfo(detectSmartDeviceAndRatio());
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleUpdate, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', handleUpdate, { passive: true });

    handleUpdate();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('orientationchange', handleUpdate);
    };
  }, []);

  // Đồng bộ khi tab khác thay đổi setting (storage event chỉ bắn giữa các tab)
  useEffect(() => {
    const onStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key !== STORAGE_KEY) return;
      if (e.newValue === 'pc' || e.newValue === 'ipad') {
        setManualMode(e.newValue as DeviceMode);
      } else if (e.newValue === null) {
        setManualMode(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage);
  }, []);

  const isAutoDetected = manualMode === null;
  const effectiveDeviceMode: DeviceMode = manualMode || autoInfo.deviceMode;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const root = document.documentElement;
      root.setAttribute('data-device-mode', effectiveDeviceMode);
      root.setAttribute('data-orientation', autoInfo.orientation);
    }
  }, [effectiveDeviceMode, autoInfo.orientation]);

  const setManualDeviceMode = useCallback((mode: DeviceMode) => {
    setManualMode(mode);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, mode);
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  const resetToAutoDetect = useCallback(() => {
    setManualMode(null);
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    } catch {}
    setAutoInfo(detectSmartDeviceAndRatio());
  }, []);

  const toggleDeviceMode = useCallback(() => {
    const nextMode: DeviceMode = effectiveDeviceMode === 'pc' ? 'ipad' : 'pc';
    setManualDeviceMode(nextMode);
  }, [effectiveDeviceMode, setManualDeviceMode]);

  const value: DeviceModeContextType = {
    deviceMode: effectiveDeviceMode,
    orientation: autoInfo.orientation,
    aspectRatio: autoInfo.aspectRatio,
    browserName: autoInfo.browserName,
    isAutoDetected,
    screenWidth: autoInfo.screenWidth,
    screenHeight: autoInfo.screenHeight,
    isTouch: autoInfo.isTouch,
    setManualDeviceMode,
    resetToAutoDetect,
    toggleDeviceMode,
  };

  return <DeviceModeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</DeviceModeContext.Provider>;
};

export const useDeviceMode = (): DeviceModeContextType => {
  const context = useContext(DeviceModeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useDeviceMode phải được sử dụng bên trong DeviceModeProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export default DeviceModeContext;

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Wifi, WifiOff, RefreshCw, Radio } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from '../components/common/Toast';

interface NetworkStatusContextType {
  isOnline: boolean;
  isReconnecting: boolean;
  lastCheckedAt: Date | null;
  checkConnection: () => Promise<boolean>;
}

const NetworkStatusContext = createContext<NetworkStatusContextType>({
  isOnline: true,
  isReconnecting: false,
  lastCheckedAt: null,
  checkConnection: async () => true,
});

export const useNetworkStatus = () => useContext(NetworkStatusContext);

export const NetworkStatusProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState<boolean>(navigator.onLine ?? true);
  const [isReconnecting, setIsReconnecting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastCheckedAt, setLastCheckedAt] = useState<Date | null>(null);

  const pingServer = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    // Nếu trình duyệt báo offline hoàn toàn
    if (!navigator.onLine) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3500);

      // Thử ping endpoint /api/health của Express 5 Gateway
      const res = await fetch('/api/health', {
        method: 'GET',
        cache: 'no-store',
        signal: controller.signal,
      });

      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      return res.ok;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }, []);

  const checkConnection = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    setIsReconnecting(true);
    const ok = await pingServer();
    setLastCheckedAt(new Date());

    setIsOnline((prev) => {
      if (!prev && ok) {
        toast.success('Đã khôi phục kết nối đến máy chủ cổng dữ liệu LAN (Port 8000).', {
          title: 'KẾT NỐI TRỰC TUYẾN',
          badge: 'LAN-ONLINE',
        });
      }
      return ok;
    });

    setIsReconnecting(false);
    return ok;
  }, [pingServer]);

  // Lắng nghe sự kiện Online / Offline của trình duyệt
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBrowserOnline = () => {
      checkConnection();
    };

    const handleBrowserOffline = () => {
      setIsOnline(false);
      toast.error('Mất tín hiệu kết nối mạng nội bộ. Đang tự động quét và kết nối lại...', {
        title: 'MẤT KẾT NỐI MÁY CHỦ',
        badge: 'LAN-OFFLINE',
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('online', handleBrowserOnline);
    window.addEventListener('offline', handleBrowserOffline);

    // Kiểm tra định kỳ mỗi 15 giây khi online, hoặc mỗi 5 giây khi offline
    const intervalTime = !isOnline ? 8000 : 0;
    const interval = intervalTime > 0 ? setInterval(() => {
      checkConnection();
    }, intervalTime) : null;

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', handleBrowserOnline);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', handleBrowserOffline);
      if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [isOnline, checkConnection]);

  return (
    <NetworkStatusContext.Provider
      value={{
        isOnline,
        isReconnecting,
        lastCheckedAt,
        checkConnection,
      }}
    >
      {children}

      {/* Lớp Phủ Tinh Tế & Hoạt Ảnh Sóng Radar Khi Mất Kết Nối Mạng */}
      {!isOnline && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-300">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md p-6 sm:p-7 rounded-2xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 border border-rose-500/50 shadow-2xl text-center space-y-5 select-none">
            {/* Vòng Tròn Radar Quét Mạng Tác Chiến */}
            <div className="relative w-28 h-28 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              {/* Vòng tròn đồng tâm */}
              <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border border-rose-500/20 radar-pulse-ring" />
              <div className="absolute inset-3 rounded-full border border-rose-500/30" />
              <div className="absolute inset-7 rounded-full border border-rose-500/40" />
              <div className="absolute inset-11 rounded-full border border-rose-500/50" />

              {/* Trục chữ thập */}

              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-1/2 w-px bg-rose-500/30 -translate-x-1/2" />

              <div
                className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full radar-sweep-line overflow-hidden pointer-events-none"
                style={{
                  background:
                    'conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4) 0deg, rgba(244, 63, 94, 0) 60deg, transparent 360deg)',
                }}
              />

              {/* Biểu tượng tâm radar */}
              <div className="relative z-10 w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-rose-950 border border-rose-500 flex items-center justify-center text-rose-400 shadow-md shadow-rose-950/60">
                <WifiOff className="w-5 h-5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 bg-rose-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-rose-500/20">

                <span>MẤT KẾT NỐI MÁY CHỦ LAN (PORT 8000)</span>
              </div>

              <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Hệ Thống Đang Cố Gắng Kết Nối Lại...
              </h3>

              <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed max-w-sm mx-auto">

              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Nút hành động thử kết nối ngay */}
            <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isReconnecting}
                onClick={() => checkConnection()}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-700 via-rose-800 to-rose-900 hover:from-rose-800 hover:to-rose-950 text-white font-semibold text-xs border border-rose-600/40 shadow-md shadow-rose-950/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isReconnecting ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                <span>{isReconnecting ? 'Đang dò sóng...' : 'Thử kết nối ngay'}</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs font-medium transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Tải lại trang
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
              Auto-reconnecting every 5s • Radar scan active
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </NetworkStatusContext.Provider>
  );
};

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';

export type Theme = 'dark' | 'light';

export interface ThemeContextType {
  theme: Theme;
  isDark: boolean;
  toggleTheme: (event?: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
}

const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'qk7_theme';

export const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<Theme>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'dark';
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (stored === 'dark' || stored === 'light') return stored;
    } catch (e) {
      // ignore
    }
    // Default to dark for QK7 DataHub
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains('light') ? 'light' : 'dark';
  });

  // Apply theme to DOM (html, body, data-theme, color-scheme)
  const applyThemeToDOM = useCallback((newTheme: Theme) => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const body = document.body;

    if (newTheme === 'dark') {
      root.classList.add('dark');
      root.classList.remove('light');
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
      root.style.colorScheme = 'dark';
      if (body) {
        body.classList.add('dark');
        body.classList.remove('light');
      }
    } else {
      root.classList.remove('dark');
      root.classList.add('light');
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
      root.style.colorScheme = 'light';
      if (body) {
        body.classList.remove('dark');
        body.classList.add('light');
      }
    }
  }, []);

  // Update state, storage, and DOM
  const setTheme = useCallback(
    (newTheme: Theme) => {
      setThemeState(newTheme);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, newTheme);
      } catch (e) {
        // ignore
      }
      applyThemeToDOM(newTheme);
    },
    [applyThemeToDOM]
  );

  // Sync on mount and listen to multi-tab storage updates
  useEffect(() => {
    applyThemeToDOM(theme);

    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key === THEME_STORAGE_KEY && (e.newValue === 'dark' || e.newValue === 'light')) {
        setThemeState(e.newValue);
        applyThemeToDOM(e.newValue);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
  }, [theme, applyThemeToDOM]);

  // <!-- Lucian UX/UI Prompt #219 · MIT License (c) 2026 Seokwoooo · https://lucianlabs.dev/uxui-prompt/#219 -->
  // Toggle with Circular-reveal animated transition
  const toggleTheme = useCallback(
    (event?: React.MouseEvent) => {
      const nextTheme: Theme = theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';

      // Check View Transitions API support
      const hasViewTransitions =
        typeof document !== 'undefined' &&
        'startViewTransition' in document &&
        typeof (document as any).startViewTransition === 'function' &&
        !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

      if (hasViewTransitions) {
        const root = document.documentElement;
        // Tọa độ tâm vòng tròn (--cx, --cy) tính toán chính xác từ getBoundingClientRect() của nút bấm
        const cxVar = root.style.getPropertyValue('--cx');
        const cyVar = root.style.getPropertyValue('--cy');
        const x = cxVar ? parseFloat(cxVar) : (event?.clientX ?? window.innerWidth - 60);
        const y = cyVar ? parseFloat(cyVar) : (event?.clientY ?? 32);

        try {
          const transition = (document as any).startViewTransition(() => {
            setTheme(nextTheme);
          });

          if (transition && transition.ready) {
            transition.ready
              .then(() => {
                // Hiệu ứng lan tỏa hình tròn (clip-path: circle) từ 0px ra 150vmax phủ kín toàn màn hình
                document.documentElement.animate(
                  {
                    clipPath: [
                      `circle(0px at ${x}px ${y}px)`,
                      `circle(150vmax at ${x}px ${y}px)`
                    ]
                  },
                  {
                    duration: 700,
                    easing: 'cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1)',
                    pseudoElement: '::view-transition-new(root)'
                  }
                );
              })
              .catch(() => {
                setTheme(nextTheme);
              });
          }
          return;
        } catch (e) {
          // Fall through to standard transition
        }
      }

      // Smooth CSS transition fallback
      document.documentElement.classList.add('theme-transition');
      setTheme(nextTheme);
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('theme-transition');
      }, 400);
    },
    [theme, setTheme]
  );

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider
      value={{
        theme,
        isDark: theme === 'dark',
        toggleTheme,
        setTheme
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = (): ThemeContextType => {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    // Resilient fallback when component is rendered without ThemeProvider
    const isDark =
      typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') : true;
    return {
      theme: isDark ? 'dark' : 'light',
      isDark,
      toggleTheme: () => {
        const next = isDark ? 'light' : 'dark';
        if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
          if (next === 'dark') {
            document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
          } else {
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
            document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
          }
        }
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, next);
        } catch (e) {}
      },
      setTheme: (newTheme) => {
        if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
          if (newTheme === 'dark') {
            document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
          } else {
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
            document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
          }
        }
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, newTheme);
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    };
  }
  return context;
};
